We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can bridge the gap between business problems and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, identify opportunities for AI adoption, and build Proofs of Concept (POCs) using Generative AI and LLM technologies.

Work with frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to develop AI-powered applications and workflows.

Integrate AI solutions with APIs, databases, enterprise applications, and third-party systems.

Present POC outcomes, technical recommendations, and potential business impact to stakeholders.

Iterate on solutions based on stakeholder feedback and help transition successful POCs into production.

Stay updated on emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications for business problems.

4+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, solution engineering, or a related technical role.

Hands-on experience building AI/ML or Generative AI applications and working with LLMs.

Proficiency in Python and experience developing APIs or backend applications.

Practical knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.

Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI orchestration tools.

Ability to rapidly prototype and demonstrate working AI solutions.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, presentation, and communication skills.

Ability to explain technical concepts and AI capabilities to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience building AI agents, multi-step workflows, or agentic AI solutions.

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Experience with AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, and deployment.

Previous experience in a client-facing, consulting, product, or forward-deployed engineering role.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on problem solver who can understand business requirements, engage stakeholders, identify AI opportunities, and independently build AI POCs that demonstrate measurable business value.

title: Product Builder
description:
**Role: Product Builder**

* Gurgaon, with US hours overlap and US dealer visits
* Full-time, Reports to the Head of Product

**Hear the problem on Monday. Ship the fix on Tuesday.**

Most companies split this job across 4 people. Support hears the complaint, a CSM writes it up, a PM prioritizes it, and an engineer builds it weeks later. By then the customer has stopped asking. We want 1 person who does all 4.

**About Spyne**

Spyne builds AI for US car dealerships. Our products run inside 1,500+ rooftops. Studio AI gets every car photographed, merchandised and online faster. Vini AI answers every sales and service call, text and chat a dealership gets, around the clock. Dealers buy outcomes: cars that sell sooner, phones that get answered, service bays that stay full.

As a Product Builder, you close the gap between what a dealer tells us and what our product does about it. You hear the problem, decide what to build, write the code and show the dealer the result.

**What you'll do**

* **Own a set of dealer accounts end to end.**
  You're their technical point of contact. When a GM, service manager or BDC lead has a problem, it comes to you.
* **Diagnose before you build.**
  A dealer says "Vini isn't booking enough appointments." You pull the call logs, find the intents it's mishandling, and work out whether the cause is a prompt, a workflow, an integration or a missing feature.
* **Turn asks into product.**
  You write the 1-page spec, decide what's a one-off config and what should become a feature for every dealer, and get it on the roadmap.
* **Write the code yourself.**
  Agent configs, conversation flows, CRM and DMS integrations, dealer-facing dashboards, eval sets. You ship to production in the areas you own and go through engineering review for core platform changes.
* **Close the loop.**
  You tell the dealer what changed, show the before and after, and check that it moved the number they cared about.
* **Take your support shift.**
  Part of every week is live support. It keeps you close to what's breaking.
* **Find the patterns.**
  When 5 dealers ask for the same thing in different words, you notice and turn it into 1 product change.

**Who you are**

* **An engineer first.**
  1 to 3 years total, with at least 2 years shipping production code. You're fluent in Python or TypeScript, you can find your way around someone else's codebase on day 1, and you've built with LLMs: prompts, agents, tool calls, evals.
* **A former founder, or close to it.**
  You started something. Maybe it didn't work. You learned to talk to customers, decide with half the information and ship it yourself because nobody else would. We see that as the best preparation for this job.
* **Someone customers trust.**
  You can sit with a dealer principal who has no interest in AI and leave with the real problem. You explain trade-offs in plain English and you pick up the phone instead of hiding behind tickets.
* **A product thinker.**
  You know the difference between what a customer asks for and what they need. You can say no to a request and offer something better.
* **High agency.**
  You move without waiting for a spec, a ticket or permission. If something's broken for a dealer, you treat it as yours until it's fixed.

**Bonus points**

* You've worked in an industry and sold to non-technical operators (restaurants, clinics, home services).
* You've done a stint in support, solutions engineering, implementation or as a Forward Deployed Engineer.
* You've built voice or conversational AI, or integrated with a CRM or ERP.

**Why this job**

* **You see the whole loop.**
  You hear the problem, design the fix, write the code and watch the dealer's numbers move, often in the same week.
* **It's the job we're building the company around.**
  Every new Spyne product stays with the product team until its first 10 to 15 customers are live and succeeding. Product Builders are how that happens.
* **You're early in a market that's moving.**
  Anthropic, OpenAI, Decagon and Sierra all hire engineers to sit with customers. You'll do that work in a vertical where AI is still new and dealer feedback is direct.
* **The path compounds.**
  This role leads to Product Lead, Engineering Lead or running a business unit. Or to your next company, with far better odds than last time.

**How we hire**

5 rounds, each testing 1 part of the job. Rounds 1 to 3 run as a chain: the problem you uncover in round 1 is the one you design in round 2 and build in round 3.

1. **Round 1: Business and customer deep dive.**
   We play a dealer with a real, messy problem. You ask the questions, find what's actually costing them money and play it back in their words. We're testing how quickly you get to the real problem and whether the customer would trust you.
2. **Round 2: Product thinking.**
   You turn that problem into a product flow: who does what, where the agent steps in, what's a one-off config and what becomes a feature for every dealer. You write it as a 1-page spec and defend what you cut.
3. **Round 3: Build with agentic AI.**
   You take your flow and ship a working change using the AI coding tools you'd use on the job, such as Claude Code or Cursor. We care about how you direct the agents, review their output and test what you ship, as much as the result.
4. **Round 4: Culture fit with the hiring manager.**
   We talk through your story: what you built, what didn't work and what you'd do differently. We're looking for high agency and ownership.
5. **Round 5: HR and closure.**
   Compensation, joining date and any open questions.

G2 ranks Birdeye #1 in Enterprise Multi-Location Marketing Platforms and named it to the 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list. Learn more at birdeye.com.

Every day, local businesses miss a large share of their inbound calls — and in appointment-driven industries, every missed call is a lost patient, a lost repair job, a lost service visit. Front desks are understaffed, phones ring after hours, and customers who don’t get through simply call the next provider. Birdeye’s AI Voice Agents group exists to fix this: AI agents that answer every call naturally, book and reschedule appointments directly into the systems businesses already run on, and give owners complete visibility into every conversation and outcome.
  
  
As Senior Director of Engineering, you will lead this group end to end: the real-time voice agent platform, a CRM/PMS integrations and data-sync layer handling business-contact data at massive scale, and the conversation dashboard where customers see every call, booking, and insight. You inherit an existing engineering team — the mandate combines 0-to-1 product urgency with the leadership challenge of aligning that team around one architecture, raising the delivery bar, and shipping GA products across four verticals.
  
  
The role is based in India, leading Birdeye’s India-based Voice Agents engineering team with direct exposure to US product leadership and customers. You will report to senior R&D leadership and partner daily with Product, Design, and the partnerships team driving CRM/EHR/FSM/DMS alliances. You lead from the front: deeply technical, close to the code where it matters — architecture decisions, critical-path reviews, and agent-quality evals.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Voice agent platform: real-time conversational pipeline (telephony, ASR, LLM orchestration, TTS), sub-second latency, barge-in handling, graceful human handoff, and per-vertical conversation design for appointment booking, rescheduling, and reminders.
* Integrations & data sync: bidirectional sync of business contacts, calendars, and appointments with EHR/PMS (e.g., Epic, Dentrix, Eaglesoft), FSM (e.g., ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro), DMS (e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion), and horizontal CRMs — reliable at tens of millions of records with conflict resolution, idempotency, and audit trails.
* Conversation dashboard & analytics: the customer-facing surface for full conversation history, transcripts, booking outcomes, containment/conversion metrics, and agent-quality analytics across locations.
* The team: lead the existing engineering team (voice/ML, backend/integrations, frontend, QA) through managers and senior ICs; shape team structure around the platform/integrations / dashboard pillars, develop and hire leaders, and establish on-call, quality bars, and eval-driven development for agent behavior.
* Execution & operating cadence: fast, predictable release cycles — planning, weekly reviews, and retrospectives that drive improvement; clear technical plans and milestones with trade-offs made explicit.
* Trust & compliance: HIPAA (BAAs), SOC 2, telephony/TCPA compliance, and safe-AI guardrails for autonomous customer-facing conversations.

****What success looks like:****

* GA voice agent live in at least two verticals with measurable booking-conversion and call-containment targets.
* Certified, bidirectional integrations with the top systems of record in each launch vertical.
* Conversation dashboard adopted as a daily surface by customers; analytics driving retention and upsell.
* The team operating as a high-performing unit: clear team charters, a strong manager bench, predictable delivery, and production-grade reliability (99.9%+ voice uptime).

****What we're looking for:****

* 15+ years in software engineering, 6+ years leading large engineering teams through managers of managers, including inheriting and re-aligning an existing team.
* A blend of large-scale engineering rigor and startup speed — e.g., senior tenure at a global-scale technology organization plus experience at a high-growth startup.
* Leadership at an AI-native product company (agents, enterprise search/RAG, conversational AI, or ML-heavy
* consumer platforms) — you have shipped AI products to demanding users, not just prototyped them.
* Shipped and operated real-time and/or high-scale distributed systems in production — voice/video, telephony, streaming, or large-scale data synchronization.
* Hands-on familiarity with the modern LLM/voice stack (ASR/TTS, agent orchestration, evals, prompt/tool design) and pragmatic judgment on build-vs-buy (e.g., Retell/Vapi-class infra vs. in-house).
* Experience integrating with third-party systems of record (CRM, EHR/PMS, FSM, or DMS) and running partner-facing engineering relationships.
* 0-to-1 product instincts at scale: comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration against real customer calls, and shipping before everything is perfect — while keeping a large org focused.
* Strong cross-functional operator: partners tightly with Product, Design, GTM, and external partners; communicates crisply with executives.

****Nice to Have:****

* Domain experience in healthcare, dental, home services, or automotive software; HIPAA/SOC 2 exposure.
* Prior experience at a vertical SaaS or SMB-focused platform company.
* Experience with contact-center or CCaaS technology, SIP/WebRTC, or conversational analytics.
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science or a related field; publications or patents in search, ML, or distributed systems.
* Experience leading India-based engineering orgs building for US/global customers, and operating across India–US time zones.
* A visible commitment to building inclusive teams — e.g., mentoring, women-in-tech advocacy, or community leadership.

****AI First Mindset:****
AI fluency is core to how we work. We expect leaders to use AI daily in their own workflow — and as part of the interview process, you’ll walk us through how you use AI tools today to drive impact in your role and your team’s.

title: (Senior) Workday Consultant — Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
You will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology — deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions.You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation — using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram or Bangalore (India), with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle — conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions.
* Help build, deploy and maintain Claude-based applications and AI-powered internal tools, working with our cloud and technology teams to ensure appropriate authentication (RBAC/ABAC), governance and HRIS-aligned access controls including MCPs, APIs and custom connectors that securely connect AI applications with the wider HR Tech landscape.
* Design and build AI and automation workflows using technologies such as n8n, UiPath, Python-based automation and GenAI/LLMs, creating scalable solutions with appropriate orchestration, exception handling, monitoring and governance.
* Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration.
* Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value.

**About You**

* 6+ years of experience as an HR Tech Analyst, HR Business/Process Analyst, AI & Automation Analyst or similar role, with deep, demonstrable HR & Workday domain knowledge across hire-to-retire processes. This is a must-have for the role. A degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, HR Technology, Business Technology or a related field is preferred.
* Strong ability to analyse HR processes, translate business problems into functional and technical requirements, and implement solutions across a complex Workday technology landscape.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation solutions using technologies such as n8n, Python scripts, UiPath and GenAI/LLM tooling. n8n certification is a plus.
* Experience building and deploying internal applications in cloud environments, including working with APIs, MCPs, custom connectors and integrations to securely move data between enterprise systems.
* Hands-on understanding of Claude/GenAI application deployment and enterprise security, including RBAC/ABAC, authentication, access governance and protection of sensitive HR data.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence, Rovo Agents and BPMN, with the ability to build service desks, portals, workflows, process frameworks and technology-enabled HR services.
* Fluency in English. Mandatory Workday experience is essential; certifications in Workday, business/process analysis, automation or agile delivery (e.g. Six Sigma, SAFe, Scrum, PMP, Archimate) are a plus.
* Comfort working across European, APAC and US time zones, with a primary collaboration focus on a Berlin-based team.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
  
  
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together business-critical operations - such as Enterprise Procurement & Payables, Global Finance & Operations Services, and Executive Support Services - alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and Meetings & Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation, while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
  
  
As an Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Senior Manager, you will work at the intersection of business operations, technology, and AI transformation. Reporting to the Enterprise Services GenAI Deployment Director, you will partner closely with ES service lines to identify, design, deploy, and scale GenAI-enabled solutions that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance employee and business outcomes.
  
  
This is a highly hands-on role. You will embed within service lines, understand operational challenges firsthand, identify high-value use cases, and help translate business needs into practical AI-enabled workflows and solutions. You will work directly with product, engineering, data, and business stakeholders to accelerate adoption and ensure solutions deliver measurable value.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to build strong business process understanding and the ability to apply GenAI technologies pragmatically to real-world business problems. You will help functions move from experimentation to sustained adoption while contributing to the development of repeatable deployment methodologies and best practices across Enterprise Services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
**AI Solution Deployment & Adoption**

* Partner with ES service lines to identify and prioritize high-value GenAI use cases
* Translate business requirements into AI-enabled workflows, prototypes, and deployment plans
* Support implementation, testing, rollout, and stabilization of AI-enabled solutions
* Drive adoption through training, change management, documentation, and stakeholder engagement
* Monitor solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization and scale

Business Partnership & Value Realization
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with operational leaders and subject matter experts across Enterprise Services
* Understand end-to-end business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and employee experience through GenAI
* Use data and operational insights to quantify impact and prioritize investments
* Surface risks, dependencies, and adoption challenges early and help drive resolution

**Capability Building & Continuous Improvement**

* Contribute to deployment playbooks, methodologies, and reusable implementation patterns
* Share lessons learned and best practices across functions and deployments
* Promote AI-enabled ways of working and support the development of AI capabilities across Enterprise Services
* Stay current on emerging GenAI tools, technologies, and deployment approaches relevant to Enterprise Services operations

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in operations transformation, process improvement, consulting, product deployment, business technology, or related fields
* Demonstrated experience working with AI, automation, workflow technologies, or digital transformation initiatives
* Strong understanding of Enterprise Services-type processes, such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Real Estate, Travel, or other operational functions
* Experience partnering with technical, product, data, or engineering teams to implement technology-enabled solutions
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, drive execution, and deliver measurable business outcomes
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work closely with Enterprise Services leadership, product and engineering teams, AI and Data functions, and operational stakeholders across BCG. You will partner with cross-functional teams globally to deploy and scale AI-enabled capabilities that improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and enhance employee and business outcomes.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Taking a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves approach to solving business problems using AI and automation
* Understanding operational processes and identifying practical opportunities to improve them through technology
* Translating business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions and workflows
* Working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Driving adoption and change in complex, matrixed environments
* Using data and insight to prioritize opportunities and measure business impact
* Operating effectively in ambiguity and adapting quickly as technologies and priorities evolve
* Communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to a range of audiences

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Executive - Data Issue Management and Governance
description:

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year

title: SC Digitalization Analyst
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Supply Chain Digitalization Analyst supports the execution of the Supply Chain Digitalization strategy by maintaining high-quality Supply Chain data and delivering advanced analytics, insights, and Power BI solutions. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. The Analyst also supports the lifecycle management of dashboards and analytical tools aligned with global Supply Chain priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Supply Chain Data Maintenance, Quality & Governance: Maintain, cleanse, harmonize, and improve Supply Chain data across operational, planning, inventory, service, cost, working capital, and performance domains. Resolve data inconsistencies through root cause analysis and sustainable fixes, while supporting Data Governance standards, definitions, documentation, and issue escalation.
* Analytics Solution Development, Data Modeling & Digital Tools: Translate Supply Chain requirements into data models, semantic models, Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with data strategy and architecture. Partner with stakeholders to support Power BI builds and scalable analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform / PowerApps, where applicable.
* Reporting Lifecycle, Automation & Standardization: Maintain and improve global and regional Supply Chain scorecards, dashboards, and recurring reports. Manage refresh validation, issue resolution, enhancements, documentation, user support, KPI alignment, and report consolidation, while driving automation and standardization to improve scalability and consistency.
* Advanced Analytics, Data-Driven Insights & Supply Chain Optimization: Develop advanced analytics and network optimization models using complex Supply Chain data to improve operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, cost, and risk management. Partner with internal Supply Chain and cross-functional teams gather data, maintain accurate baseline network models, evaluate customer shipping points, and assess strategic network opportunities, including greenfield locations and point-of-manufacturing options. Identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities, then translate insights into actionable recommendations that optimize transportation mileage, facility utilization, total Supply Chain cost, and ways of working.

* Demonstrated ability to perform advanced data analysis and generate actionable insights

* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional group required. Strong written and oral communication skills are required.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to analyze complex problems to identify and correct root causes with minimum supervision.
* Ability to self-manage and operate independently in environments that may not be black and white
* Operates as a continuous learner, proactively asking questions, challenges status quo and makes recommendations for improvement. Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate effectively at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working with or in the Supply Chain function
* Previous use of Supply Chain Guru / Llamasoft, or comparable Network Modeling software
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, and existing network optimization analyses.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Role:**
Lead AI Engineer

**Function:**
Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Engineering

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.

A team of 740 operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation. Engineers here build AI products that touch millions of listeners, creators, and advertisers daily.

**Position Overview**

The company is building AI products for listeners, creators, and advertisers — and this role sits at the centre of that effort. As a senior individual contributor, you will take fuzzy business conversations and turn them into shipped, measurable AI systems: designing the architecture, building the pipelines, and owning the outcomes. This is not a research role — the bar is production, not demos.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Translate business-level asks ('smarter recommendations', 'automate the ad-copy thing') into concrete technical designs — components, data flows, model choices, cost estimates, and a build plan; write specs when needed and push back when AI is the wrong tool.
* Design full AI systems end-to-end: service boundaries, APIs, queues, caching, vector and SQL storage, latency budgets, failure modes, and observability dashboards — with cost-per-request and SLOs as first-class concerns.
* Build and ship LLM-powered products using structured prompting, few-shot patterns, prompt versioning, evals, and guardrails; implement multi-step agentic workflows using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks with state management, tool calling, and retries.
* Architect and maintain RAG pipelines — chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search and reranking, retrieval quality evaluation, and index freshness.
* Measure everything: offline evals, online A/B tests, and real numbers on quality, latency, and cost; 'it feels better' is a gut-check, not a launch criterion.
* Make model routing and hosting decisions across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models; evaluate self-hosting trade-offs and fine-tuning ROI honestly.
* Mentor engineers, run design reviews, and own your slice of the AI product roadmap — keeping the team current on a fast-moving ecosystem without chasing every shiny repo.

title: Systems Architect (Staff Architect II), TSG Software Engineering
description:
**Company Profile**
Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
  
  
Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
  
  
The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
  
  
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.
  
  
Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
You’ll work across all of Bain’s TSG software engineering teams working with Engineering Managers, Developers, and vendor delivery partners. These teams build and support Bain’s most strategic internal software systems, primarily enterprise-scale, browser-based or mobile applications with a global user base.
  
  
Teams combine internal developers with vendor-augmented developers, work in an Agile/kanban model, and increasingly use AI-assisted and agent-assisted development. You will also work closely with Information Security, infrastructure and cloud teams, and procurement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
The Systems Architect is a senior technical leadership role. The role is the technical authority across all engineering teams for software architecture, non-functional requirements (NFRs), secure development, testing, deployment, and the use of AI in engineering. The role sets standards, builds guardrails, makes tooling decisions, and acts as a technical evangelist, working through Engineering Managers and developers to create consistency across teams.
  
  
Where capacity allows, the role also takes on end-to-end delivery of selected projects. Percentages below are indicative and will flex with project delivery commitments.
  
  
**Architecture and engineering standards (20%)**

* Define and maintain a unified software architecture approach across all teams, including reference architectures, design patterns, integration and API standards, and architecture decision records.
* Act as design authority for significant new systems and major upgrades, reviewing solution designs for fit with standards, scalability, resilience, security, and cost.
* Define NFRs such as performance, availability, scalability, security, observability, and maintainability, and make sure they are built into designs, estimates, and development practices.
* Guide data architecture choices across SQL, NoSQL, and vector databases so teams make consistent, well-reasoned decisions.
* Advise on the modernization, rationalization, or retirement of legacy applications, working with AMS leads and Engineering Managers on technical roadmaps and technical debt.
* Ensure vendor-augmented teams follow the same architecture and engineering standards as internal teams.

**NFR and system inventory (10%)**

* Own the NFR system, templates, and process by which NFRs are captured, validated, tracked, and verified for every product.
* Own the inventory of all applications and legacy systems, and keep it current and complete, covering technology stack, ownership, dependencies, hosting, and lifecycle status.
* Drive up-to-date documentation of software systems and processes, and set documentation standards for teams.

**Secure software development | AI-enabled engineering and agent guardrails (25%)**

* Define and own secure software development practices across teams, including threat modeling, secure design review, dependency and supply chain security, secrets management, and code scanning.
* Work with InfoSec to turn policy into practical engineering controls and serve as the technical escalation point for security questions.
* Set controls for the secure use of AI-generated code and AI agents, including protection of data and prompts.
* Review vulnerability and remediation trends across teams and drive corrective action.
* Define standards for the use of code assistants and AI coding agents, including approved tools, usage practices, review of AI-generated code, and how impact is measured.
* Design and maintain guardrails for AI agents, including permissions, handling of data and prompts, human review checkpoints, auditability, and failure handling.
* Promote AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices and their adoption across teams.
* Define architecture patterns for LLM-based applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vectorization and embeddings, vector databases, evaluation, cost, and latency.
* Track emerging AI risks and ensure approaches align with Bain’s governance and responsible AI expectations.

**Cloud, deployment, and DevOps (15%)**

* Finalize and govern deployment approaches across Azure, GCP, and AWS, including criteria for workload placement, environment strategy, and infrastructure as code.
* Standardize CI/CD pipelines, release strategies, and observability practices across teams.
* Partner with infrastructure and cloud teams on cost, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Verify that NFRs are met in deployed environments.

**Tooling, licensing, procurement, and proofs of concept (10%)**

* Make and recommend tool choices across IDEs, code assistants, testing, CI/CD, security, and observability, with clear evaluation criteria and rationale as and when there is a decision point.
* Manage tool licenses for all teams, internal and vendor-augmented, and optimize usage and cost.
* Lead procurement of tools, including requirements, vendor evaluation, commercial input, and onboarding, with procurement and reporting to the TS leadership.
* Lead or sponsor proof of concept on emerging technologies for different teams, with clear success criteria and a recommendation to adopt, defer, or drop. Present findings to the wider engineering group.

**Technical mentoring (15%)**

* Act as technical evangelist across teams through communities of practice, tech talks, and architecture forums, building shared understanding of standards and the reasons behind them.
* Communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.
* Coach and mentor developers and Engineering Managers on design, architecture, and technical decision-making to build architecture capability across the group.
* Report to the TS leadership and give Engineering Managers regular feedback on the technical health of teams.
* Role model assertive communication in crucial conversations, and listen to understand the needs of teams.

**Project delivery (5%)**

* Take end-to-end ownership of selected delivery projects when availability permits, from architecture through build, testing, release, and handover.
* Report to the TS leadership on project selection, and make sure standards and governance responsibilities are not compromised.
* Build hands-on prototypes and technical spikes to validate approaches before wider adoption.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Teams share consistent architecture, NFR, testing, security, and deployment approaches, and Engineering Managers and developers treat the Systems Architect as the reference point.
* AI coding tools and agents are used safely and productively, within clear guardrails.
* NFRs are captured and verified for every product, and App Stack AI is complete and trusted.
* Tool licenses and procurement are managed with clear ownership, and proofs of concept lead to timely adoption decisions.

**About You**

* 15+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in architecture or senior technical leadership roles spanning multiple systems and teams.
* Demonstrated record as architect or design authority for enterprise-scale applications, setting standards that were adopted across several teams.
* Experience working with distributed teams that combine internal and vendor-augmented developers.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development and LLM-based applications, and the ability to define practical guardrails for AI agents.
* Strong grounding in secure software development practices.
* Experience designing and deploying on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, GCP, or AWS), with working knowledge of the others.
* Experience evaluating tools, managing licenses, supporting procurement, and running proofs of concept.
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority, and to earn credibility with engineers and senior stakeholders alike.
* Strong communication, listening, and customer service skills.
* Strong analytic and problem-solving skills.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree.

**Software engineering: technical skills**

* Architecture: scalable, secure, and maintainable system design, including microservices, event-driven patterns, API design, integration patterns, and NFR definition.
* Backend languages and frameworks: Python, C#, .NET, and .NET Core.
* Web frameworks and libraries: Angular, React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
* AI and Gen AI: LLMs, ML, MLOps/ AIOps, prompt design, RAG, AI agents, AI coding assistants, agent guardrails, and evaluation.
* Vector databases and vectorization: embedding models, vector stores, indexing, and retrieval tuning.
* SQL databases: Microsoft SQL Server, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or equivalent.
* NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cosmos DB, or equivalent.
* Cloud: Azure, GCP, and AWS, including infrastructure as code and workload placement.
* DevOps: CI/CD pipelines, release management, containers, and observability.
* Testing: Exposure to unit testing, API and end-to-end testing, and performance testing tools.
* Secure development: threat modeling, SAST and DAST, dependency scanning, and secrets management.
* Architecture documentation: C4 or UML modeling and architecture decision records.

title: AI Engineer (Agentic Systems, Deployment & Infrastructure Sizing)
description:
**AI Engineer (Agentic Systems, Deployment & Infrastructure Sizing)**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a specialized AI Engineer with deep expertise in architecting, building, and deploying autonomous AI Agents alongside a strong command of the underlying hardware and software infrastructure required to run them efficiently. Unlike purely API-bound developers, you will be responsible for the full stack: designing multi-agent workflows, implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and tool-use pipelines, and sizing/optimizing the compute infrastructure (GPUs, VRAM, local/on-premise servers, and cloud instances) to balance latency, accuracy, and operational cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**● AI Agent Development:**
Design, build, and orchestrate autonomous single- and multi-agent systems capable of complex reasoning, planning, memory management, and external tool/API execution (using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestrators).

**● Hardware Sizing & Infrastructure Architecture:**
Evaluate, specify, and procure/provision hardware stacks for local, edge, or data-center AI workloads. Calculate exact GPU compute, VRAM bandwidth, CPU, RAM,storage IOPS, and thermal/power requirements for running open-weight LLMs, vision models, and embedding pipelines.

**● Model Deployment & Serving Optimization:**
Deploy and serve open-source and proprietary models using high-throughput inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server, Ollama). Apply quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, GGUF, FP8) to maximize throughput on target hardware.

**● RAG & Enterprise Integration:**
Build production-grade vector search pipelines (Milvus, Qdrant, pgvector) and securely connect AI agents to internal databases, ERPs, document management systems, and IoT/operational data streams.

**● Software Stack & MLOps:**
Containerize and orchestrate AI services using Docker, Kubernetes, and NVIDIA Container Toolkit (CUDA/cuDNN stack management). Set up CI/CD pipelines for agent evaluation, observability (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, Prometheus), and guardrails.

**● Cost & Performance Benchmarking:**
Continuously benchmark token generation speeds, Time-To-FirstToken (TTFT), concurrency limits, and cost-per-1k-tokens between self-hosted hardware and commercial cloud APIs. Required

Qualifications & Skills

**● Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech/M.S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.

**● Experience:**
3–5+ years in Software/ML Engineering, with at least 1.5–2+ years specifically focused on LLMs, GenAI, and Agentic workflows in production.

**● Agentic & LLM Stack:**
Advanced Python proficiency; deep familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks, function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), structured outputs, and vector databases.

**● Infrastructure & Hardware Mastery:**
Deep understanding of GPU architectures (NVIDIA RTX Ada/Blackwell workstation cards, L40S, A100, H100), VRAM calculation for model weights + KV cache + context windows, multi-GPU tensor parallelism, and Linux server administration.

**● Inference & Optimization:**
Hands-on experience with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, ONNX Runtime, model quantization techniques, and fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA).

title: OPEX Executive – Process Improvement, AI & Automation
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, tech-savvy OPEX Executive who can identify operational inefficiencies, improve business processes and build technology-driven solutions that help our company operate more efficiently.

You will work closely with leadership and different departments to understand how work gets done, identify where time and resources are being wasted, and implement practical solutions using AI, automation and internal tools.

This could involve evaluating a department's workflow to reduce unnecessary manual work, building an internal training academy using existing SOPs, developing dashboards to track performance, or automating repetitive reporting tasks.

We are looking for someone who can take a business problem statement, determine the best way to solve it, and turn it into a working solution quickly. For smaller projects, the expectation is to develop a functional first version within 24–48 hours where the scope permits, then test and improve it based on feedback.

**This is a hands-on implementation role. You will be expected to identify problems, build solutions, implement improvements and measure the results — not simply prepare reports or make recommendations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Process Improvement & Time Efficiency**

* Evaluate existing company processes across departments to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, duplicated work and unnecessary manual tasks.
* Conduct time-and-motion analysis to understand how long tasks take, where time is being lost and how workflows can be improved.
* Map existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce steps and improve turnaround times.
* Work with department heads and team members to understand operational challenges and identify practical improvements.
* Develop and implement solutions that reduce administrative workload, repetitive tasks and dependency on manual follow-ups.
* Measure the impact of improvements by tracking time saved, productivity, error reduction and process turnaround times.
* Continuously review existing workflows and recommend improvements as the business grows.

**2. AI-Powered Internal Tools & Systems**

* Translate business problem statements into functional internal tools, platforms and systems.
* Build tools such as internal training academies, knowledge hubs, SOP libraries, onboarding portals and operational management systems.
* Use existing company documentation, SOPs and resources to create structured, searchable and user-friendly internal platforms.
* Use AI tools to accelerate development and turn ideas into functional prototypes quickly.
* Test solutions with end users, incorporate feedback and improve usability.
* Take ownership of tools from initial concept through implementation, maintenance and ongoing improvement.

**3. Internal Dashboards & Backend Development**

* Build and maintain internal dashboards for departmental KPIs, business performance, team productivity and operational tracking.
* Develop the underlying data structures, workflows, logic and integrations required to make dashboards functional.
* Connect relevant data sources and internal tools to reduce manual reporting and improve data visibility.
* Update dashboards and systems as business requirements evolve.
* Ensure tools are accurate, reliable, easy to use and appropriately access-controlled.

**4. AI, Prompt Engineering & Rapid Prototyping**

* Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and AI-assisted coding platforms to build, troubleshoot and improve internal solutions.
* Write effective prompts and structured instructions to develop functional tools and automate processes.
* Identify the most appropriate combination of AI tools, no-code platforms, integrations and coding for each problem.
* Experiment with new technologies to find faster and more effective ways of working.
* Validate AI-generated outputs, troubleshoot errors and ensure solutions work as intended.
* Stay informed about emerging AI capabilities and identify opportunities to apply them across the business.

**5. Workflow Automation & System Integration**

* Identify repetitive tasks and manual workflows that can be automated.
* Build automations connecting internal systems, forms, databases, dashboards and reporting tools.
* Reduce manual data entry, duplicated work and unnecessary communication between departments.
* Improve information flow, accountability and visibility across teams.
* Document automated workflows and maintain clear instructions for ongoing use.

**6. System Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve existing dashboards, internal tools, automations and workflows.
* Respond to changing business requirements and implement updates promptly.
* Troubleshoot issues, resolve errors and maintain data accuracy.
* Update SOPs and process documentation whenever workflows change.
* Monitor whether implemented solutions are delivering the intended results.
* Take ownership of the systems you build instead of relying on external developers for routine changes.

**Skills & Experience**

* 2–4 years of experience in operations, process improvement, business systems, automation, internal tool development or a related field.
* Demonstrable experience building functional dashboards, internal tools, web applications or automated workflows.
* Practical experience using AI tools to develop and improve digital solutions.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into structured solutions and working prototypes.
* Understanding of workflow mapping, process optimisation, root-cause analysis or time-and-motion analysis.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding, no-code/low-code development or frontend development.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, databases, data structures and system integrations.
* Experience with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, ClickUp, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, n8n, Make or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly and work independently.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different departments.
* Understanding of data security, access permissions, testing and system reliability.
* **Travel:**
  Must be comfortable travelling between Delhi and Gurgaon as required.

Candidates do not need expertise in every tool listed. We value practical building ability, analytical thinking, initiative and speed of execution over familiarity with a specific technology stack.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You are someone who:

* **Thinks in solutions:**
  You can take a business problem and determine how best to solve it.
* **Identifies inefficiencies:**
  You naturally question why a process exists, how long it takes and whether it could be done better.
* **Builds quickly:**
  You can develop a functional first version within hours or days rather than spending weeks planning.
* **Uses AI effectively:**
  You know how to prompt, build, debug and refine solutions using AI tools.
* **Understands systems:**
  You can work with dashboards, data, workflows, integrations and internal processes.
* **Takes ownership:**
  You implement solutions rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Measures outcomes:**
  You look for tangible improvements in time, effort, accuracy and productivity.
* **Works independently:**
  You need the desired outcome explained, not every individual step prescribed.
* **Adapts quickly:**
  You are comfortable with changing priorities and evolving business requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first 90 days, you should be able to:

* Evaluate processes across multiple departments and identify high-impact improvement opportunities.
* Implement practical solutions that reduce manual work, wasted time and operational bottlenecks.
* Build and deploy internal dashboards and tools from business problem statements.
* Develop and improve internal platforms using existing company SOPs and resources.
* Automate repetitive workflows and reduce dependency on manual reporting.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in time efficiency, turnaround times and team productivity.
* Establish a continuous improvement process for reviewing, optimising and documenting business operations.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and examples of dashboards, internal tools, automations or process improvements you have worked on.

As part of your application, briefly explain:

1. What business or operational problem were you solving?
2. What did you personally build or improve?
3. Which tools and technologies did you use?
4. How long did it take to implement?
5. What measurable results did the solution achieve?

Practical demonstrations and working examples will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

  **healthcare institutions and wellness partners**

title: Remote Pod Lead - Math
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mathematics expert to lead a pod of 5–10 trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science.
* You will review trainer-created tasks for mathematical correctness, reproducibility, challenge, and grader reliability. You will also mentor trainers, manage quality and throughput, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mathematical research and computational workflows.
* The role covers numerical and applied mathematics, scientific computing, optimization, statistics, mathematical modeling, computational algebra, and formal verification.

**What you’ll do:**

* Review tasks end to end, including problem statements, datasets, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Verify mathematical correctness, well-posedness, convergence, stability, conditioning, discretization error, and edge-case handling.
* Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step reasoning rather than lookup or a single library call.
* Validate that exact, symbolic, arbitrary-precision, or floating-point computation is used appropriately.
* Check that tolerances are suitable for the problem’s numerical conditioning.
* Design and review graders based on mathematical properties such as residuals, feasibility, optimality certificates, invariants, error bounds, or proof checking.
* Ensure tasks are reproducible through pinned tools, libraries, solver versions, and dependencies.
* Identify and prevent hard-coded solutions, test-file leakage, and other methods of bypassing the intended computation.
* Provide precise, actionable feedback and track trainer revisions through closure.
* Mentor and onboard trainers on mathematical rigor, task design, coding practices, and evaluation standards.
* Allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
* Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.
* Collaborate with the Mathematics Team Lead and other technical stakeholders to improve benchmark quality.

**What we’re looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, MATLAB/Octave, or a computer algebra system.
* Strong Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on experience with numerical methods, scientific computing, symbolic computation, optimization, computational statistics, or mathematical modeling.
* Ability to rigorously evaluate mathematical derivations, algorithms, proofs, and computational results.
* Experience reviewing research outputs, code, mathematical work, or scientific workflows.
* Experience mentoring or leading small technical or research teams.
* Strong written communication and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback.
* Ability to assess reproducibility, test reliability, and the scientific validity of computational tasks.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, mpmath, SageMath, PARI/GP, GAP, Macaulay2, or Mathematica-like workflows.
* Experience with FEniCS, Firedrake, DifferentialEquations.jl, PETSc, or similar ODE/PDE tools.
* Experience with CVXPY, JuMP, Pyomo, HiGHS, or other optimization frameworks.
* Familiarity with Lean/mathlib, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle, or other proof assistants.
* Experience with Docker, Git, CI systems, and automated testing.
* Experience designing benchmarks, competition problems, or computational evaluations.
* Experience evaluating AI coding, reasoning, or terminal agents.
* Experience setting or judging mathematics olympiad or competition problems.
* Publications or open-source contributions in computational mathematics, numerical software, or formalized mathematics.
* Prior experience in AI training, data generation, or model evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Cyber Modelling Analyst
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL is the Property & Casualty risk division of AXA, created from the acquisition of XL Catlin in 2018. We partner with mid-sized to multinational clients to take their business further, with more than 30 lines of business to offer solutions for existing and emerging risks. With 9,000+ colleagues based in approximately 30 countries; we can serve clients in more than 200 countries.
  
  
The Cyber Accumulation Modeling Actuary will be a part of the AXA XL team, fully dedicated to supporting AXA Group Risk Management. This role requires active collaboration with GRM teams to facilitate the effective management of Cyber risks across the AXA Group.
  
  
In this capacity, you will play a key role in assisting the Group P&C Risk Management teams in the development and execution of key initiatives. Your contributions will be essential in enhancing the management of Cyber exposures and ensuring alignment with other CAT Man Made exposures (Liability).
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Participate in the development of the platform collecting entities underwriting data, working closely with IT teams (development roadmap, test developments, documentation update etc.).
* Assist in building efficient analysis tools for CAT Man Made risks: exposure reports, modelled result reports etc.
* Acquire a comprehensive understanding of AXA's Cyber Business across all entities, including covers granted, typologies of portfolios, etc.
* Analyze the evolution of entities Cyber exposure from one year to another.
* Assist in the continuous improvement of the Cyber risk model, including manipulating and gaining detailed insights into the model (written in R) to produce the various outputs needed (model runs, sensitivities, documentation, reporting templates, controls…), while contributing to the development of methodologies for assessing Cyber risk exposure.
* Collaborate with all entities involved in Cyber risk to gather underwriting data and effectively communicate model developments and results.

You will have a dual reporting line to the Head of Cyber Risk Management at AXA Group and Country Management at the AXA XL level.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field (e.g., Actuary, Data Science, Applied Mathematics).
* Relevant years of working experience, preferably in risk management or related fields.
* Expertise in actuarial science, statistics, and risk theory.
* Robust analytical skills with a proven ability to communicate findings clearly and concisely.
* Proficiency in R/Python programming language for model manipulation and development.
* Business English – fluent (spoken and written).

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Proficiency in using Databricks would be a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with robust interpersonal skills.
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing circumstances and new challenges.
* Demonstrated rigor, motivation, autonomy, and proactivity.
* Curiosity and open-mindedness to explore new ideas and approaches.

**Who WE Are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What We OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.

title: Lead, Data & AI Solutions – Enterprise Risk
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function supports Payoneer’s enterprise-wide risk governance, risk reporting, risk event management, issue management, risk assessments, controls and oversight processes.
  
  
This role will drive data, analytics, automation and AI-enabled transformation initiatives across the Risk & Resilience department. The role will lead enterprise risk data projects, strengthen risk analytics and reporting capabilities, and design and build practical AI-enabled solutions that improve Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) processes.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who can combine GRC process knowledge, system administration, data analysis, AI-enabled solution building and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will help improve how risk and governance teams operate by simplifying workflows, improving data quality, automating manual processes, enhancing reporting, and identifying where AI or in-house tools can complement existing GRC platforms.
  
  
The role is well suited to someone who is analytical, technically curious, comfortable working in a fast-paced fintech environment, and motivated to build practical tools that improve governance, risk management, compliance, audit and decision-making.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead enterprise risk data and analytics projects from problem definition and requirements gathering through data sourcing, analysis, solution design, implementation and adoption.
* Support the development and execution of ERM’s data, analytics, automation and AI transformation roadmap, including identifying and prioritising high-value initiatives.
* Design and develop risk analytics, dashboards and management reporting across areas such as enterprise risk assessments, risk events, issues, controls, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), audit findings, remediation activities, root causes and emerging risks.
* Analyse risk and GRC data to identify trends, risk concentrations, recurring themes, control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for management action.
* Design and implement automated processes for data collection, transformation, validation, analysis, reporting and stakeholder follow-up.
* Lead the design, prototyping and delivery of AI-enabled GRC solutions across risk assessments, issue management, risk event analysis, control monitoring, KRI management, reporting, knowledge management, classification, summarisation and thematic analysis.
* Translate business and risk requirements into clear solution designs, workflows, user journeys, data requirements, functional specifications, prototypes and acceptance criteria.
* Build and test practical solutions using data analytics, business intelligence, automation, generative AI and low-code or no-code development capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, AI, Security and Privacy teams to determine appropriate technical approaches, data sources, integrations, architecture and implementation models.
* Establish appropriate controls for AI and automated solutions, including data sensitivity, privacy, security, access management, validation, reliability, explainability, documentation, auditability, monitoring and human oversight.
* Lead data quality reviews and improvement initiatives, including identifying data gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate information, outdated records and reporting limitations.
* Manage AI pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives, evaluate outcomes, incorporate user feedback, and develop plans for controlled implementation and broader adoption.
* Measure the effectiveness of departmental data, automation and AI initiatives through defined success measures, including efficiency gains, data quality improvements, user adoption, reporting accuracy and decision-making value.
* Prepare risk insights, dashboards and analytical outputs for senior management, governance forums and other key stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder engagement, training, change management and adoption activities for new analytics, automation and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Support broader ERM activities and enterprise-wide risk initiatives as needed, including risk assessments, risk monitoring, governance materials, management reporting, capital modelling and strategic projects.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong experience leading data, analytics, automation or technology-enabled transformation projects, preferably within enterprise risk management, operational risk, compliance, internal audit or another governance function.
* Strong understanding of risk and GRC processes, including risk assessments, risk events, issue management, control management, KRIs, audit findings, remediation tracking and governance reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex and fragmented datasets and translate them into clear, actionable risk insights.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards, analytical tools, automated reporting or data-driven solutions using business intelligence, data visualisation, query, automation or similar technologies.
* Practical experience designing, prototyping or building AI-enabled solutions, including generative AI, workflow automation, intelligent classification, summarisation, thematic analysis or knowledge management capabilities.
* Ability to translate business and risk problems into structured requirements, data needs, solution designs and practical implementation plans.
* Understanding of data management principles, including data quality, governance, lineage, access controls, validation, documentation and reporting accuracy.
* Strong project ownership skills, with the ability to manage initiatives from concept and design through development, testing, implementation and adoption.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain data, technical, AI and risk concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* A hands-on mindset with a willingness to analyse data, build prototypes, test solutions, resolve problems, document outcomes and support implementation.
* Experience with business intelligence, data analytics, automation, low-code or no-code development, or AI-enabled development tools is strongly preferred.
* Experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Microsoft Power Platform, Lovable or similar technologies would be advantageous.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Risk Management, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, automation, AI solution delivery, risk management, GRC transformation, operational risk, compliance, internal audit, technology risk or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, automation or AI-enabled solutions from initial concept through implementation is required.
* Experience within fintech, financial services, payments, banking, technology or another regulated environment is preferred.
* Experience supporting Second Line or Third Line functions would be advantageous.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*
