You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.

title: Director, Solutions Builder (Builder Portfolio Leader)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.
  
  
Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.
  
  
The Builder Leadership Experience
  
  

* Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
* AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
* Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
* Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.
* Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
* Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.
* Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
* Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
* You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
* You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
* You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
* You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

**Even Better If...**

* Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Enable data-driven decision-making across Global Supply Management (GSM) by delivering actionable insights, predictive analytics, reporting visualizations and analytical automation. Support strategic vendor decisions, savings, risk management, efficiency, service quality and transparency through analytical tools and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data analytics and business insights**

* Translate unstructured business requests into analytical strategies and actionable insights.
* Perform analysis and research on strategic priorities using best-in-class analytical approaches, including predictive analysis, statistical modelling and data mining.
* Deliver ad-hoc analysis and clear presentations of results, including visualizations and MIS for senior leadership.
* Collaborate with analytical teams across American Express business units, using internal and external data sources to generate insights.

**Analytics tools, automation and data quality**

* Drive analytical capabilities within GSM and business units using cognitive and analytical tools and technologies.
* Enhance data collection procedures to capture information relevant to analytical systems.
* Process, cleanse and verify data integrity for analysis; create automated anomaly-detection systems and monitor their performance.
* Deliver high-quality, accurate analytical outputs on time, with close attention to detail.

**AI and GenAI enablement**

* Identify practical AI and GenAI opportunities for procurement analytics, insight generation, summarization and workflow efficiency.
* Support proofs of concept using approved AI tools and analytical technologies; evaluate accuracy, usefulness and business impact with stakeholder validation.
* Apply responsible AI principles, including data privacy, security, human review and appropriate governance when using AI-assisted outputs.
* Collaborate with business and technology partners to integrate validated AI-assisted insights into dashboards, reporting and repeatable processes.

**Solution design and stakeholder collaboration**

* Conduct feasibility studies and proofs of concept to validate functional specifications and translate them into technical specifications.
* Assess existing environments, identify opportunities and recommend alternative solutions to technical problems.
* Translate requirements into concepts and user-experience designs in partnership with stakeholders and business partners.
* Understand procurement processes and support translation of AS-IS processes into TO-BE models.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in analytics.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree relevant to the industry; additional credentials are a plus.
* Strong analytical aptitude and experience with Tableau, SQL and Alteryx.
* Strong functional knowledge of procurement processes, including AS-IS and TO-BE process models.
* Excellent visual design skills and sensitivity to user–system interaction, including complex multi-panel interactive dashboards.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to a global audience.
* Awareness of AI/ML and GenAI concepts, prompt design and responsible AI practices; willingness to learn and apply approved AI tools.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.
  
  
Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-Agentic AI engineer-Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Title: Sr. Agentic AI Engineer**
**Job Description**
Cybersecurity is seeking a
**Sr. Agentic AI Engineer**
to join the Cyber Analytics and Data Science team. This role focuses on designing, building, and operationalizing
**agentic AI systems**
, multi-agent frameworks, and intelligent automation solutions that enhance our cybersecurity posture. The ideal candidate will leverage advanced machine learning, LLM engineering, reasoning systems, and data engineering to solve enterprise-scale problems and drive the next generation of autonomous cyber-analytics capabilities.
  
  
You will be directly responsible for the
**architecture, development, deployment, and automation**
of agentic AI applications that support predictive, prescriptive, and autonomous cybersecurity operations. This role partners closely with key stakeholders across Cybersecurity, IT, and Data Engineering to accelerate the adoption of multi-agent systems, RAG-enhanced intelligence, and enterprise AI platforms.
  
  
The Sr. Agentic AI Engineer is a hands-on technologist, creative problem solver, and trusted advisor who brings deep experience with emerging AI technologies and a passion for building scalable, production-grade autonomous systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI And Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.

**RAG Systems And Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering And Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**Enterprise Agentic AI Platform**

* Lead the development of an enterprise-grade platform enabling orchestration of LLMs, RAG components, vector databases, and multi-agent protocols.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.
* Build reusable agent templates, toolkits, and internal libraries to accelerate development across Cyber teams.

**MLOps, Observability And Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.

**Data Engineering And Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 5+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Strong Python skills and working knowledge of SQL.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 1+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks.

**Preferred**

* 2+ years developing automation or RPA solutions.
* 2+ years building on AWS, including serverless architectures.
* Demonstrated experience with data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
* 2+ years working with APIs, microservices, and modern data engineering tooling.
* Applied experience with agile software development practices.
* Prior work deploying enterprise-scale agentic AI or autonomous reasoning systems.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML or agentic frameworks.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Governance and Operations Lead
description:
**Position Title:**
Governance and Operations Lead
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43985
  
  
**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**
**About The Role.**
The Governance & Operations Lead is accountable for establishing and maintaining McCain’s Responsible AI governance framework, evaluation standards, risk classification methodology, portfolio reporting, and stage-gate quality processes across the AI organization. Reporting to the VP, Artificial Intelligence, this role serves as the independent authority responsible for ensuring AI use cases are safe, reliable, compliant, and ready to scale. The position partners closely with AI, technology, risk, privacy, and architecture stakeholders while maintaining clear separation from demand intake and prioritization activities to ensure objective governance and oversight.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Own and continuously evolve McCain’s Responsible AI standards across fairness, accuracy, reliability, transparency, privacy, and accountability.
* Define evaluation methodologies, quality thresholds, and stage-gate criteria for AI use cases throughout their lifecycle.
* Lead and operate governance reviews from solution design through deployment and post-production monitoring.
* Maintain evaluation frameworks, red-teaming practices, golden datasets, and testing processes across the McCain AI technology stack.
* Oversee the Green, Yellow, and Red (RAG) risk classification framework and ensure consistent application across the AI portfolio.
* Partner with Enterprise Risk, Privacy, and Architecture teams to align governance standards, policies, and compliance requirements.
* Provide portfolio-level reporting on AI use case status, quality metrics, value realization, adoption, model accuracy, drift, and incident trends.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen quality, operational excellence, and responsible AI practices.
* Lead and develop governance team members, including Responsible AI and evaluation specialists, portfolio analysts, and future governance resources.
* Ensure audit readiness through comprehensive documentation, model cards, decision logs, regulatory support, and external assessment coordination.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Risk Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in AI/ML governance, model risk management, technology audit, risk management, or a closely related discipline.
* 2+ years of people leadership and team management experience.
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML evaluation, testing methodologies, and performance validation practices.
* Strong knowledge of Responsible AI frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, or equivalent standards.
* Experience designing and operating risk classification frameworks, model governance processes, and stage-gate review methodologies.
* Proven ability to establish rigorous quality standards while enabling delivery speed and business value.
* Experience developing executive-level reporting, portfolio analytics, and governance dashboards.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior leaders, auditors, regulators, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience within consumer packaged goods (CPG), regulated industries, or large enterprise environments is considered an asset.
* Familiarity with modern AI ecosystems, cloud platforms, enterprise data environments, and AI application governance practices.

The Governance & Operations team serves as the independent quality, risk, and governance function within McCain’s Artificial Intelligence organization. Reporting to the VP, Artificial Intelligence, the team partners closely with AI Platform & Engineering, Knowledge Engineering, Forward Deployment Engineering, Enterprise Risk, Privacy, and Architecture stakeholders. The team is responsible for defining governance standards, conducting evaluations, managing portfolio reporting, and enabling responsible, scalable AI adoption across the organization while maintaining clear separation from demand intake and prioritization activities.

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume.

title: CAT Modeling (for one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates)-
description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.
  
  
Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The Role**
An exciting opportunity for a Catastrophe Risk Analyst to join a leading Exposure Management team at one of Lloyd’s largest syndicates. The successful candidate will be delivering cutting edge analytics to stakeholders across the business for the D&F Property class, which has seen significant growth over the last 12 months. This is an excellent opportunity for a candidate looking to have a material impact at a top Lloyds’ syndicate and global (re)insurer.
  
  
As an analyst, you will have a real ability to meaningfully influence the risk selection process. The successful candidate will look to work collaboratively with various internal stakeholders to ensure timely modelling analytics to support risk pricing and wider Catastrophe Management goals.
  
  
**Skill mix: Account Modeling + Data Cleansing**
**CAT Modelers/ Sr. CAT Modelers:**
**Responsibilities:**

* Confident and timely delivery of analytics and the ability to explain how these analytics can help drive risk selection.
* Use RMS and various other tools to deliver market leading analysis both on individual account and portfolio basis.
* Work closely with the Natural Catastrophe Management team, across different regions, to ensure close communication across the team, consistent application of view of risk and contribute to cross-region analytics.
* Create a narrative based on the modelling data and other sources to effectively provide a valuable summary of a certain risk and give advice to Underwriters on the strengths and weaknesses of both the data and the model’s ability to provide meaningful results. This includes communicating the concept of uncertainty.
* Communicate risk metrics to key stakeholders.
* Coordinate with the Analytics and Reporting team to ensure timely delivery of data required for internal and external reporting.

**Skills and Experience:**

* Experience in a Cat Modelling role – RMS experience is highly desirable and D&F Property class experience is advantageous.
* Highly numerate and logical – strong mathematical/statistical knowledge is advantageous.
* Excellent business communication skills – ability to influence, negotiate, and listen.
* Ability to manipulate large data sets with strong Excel and SQL skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Power BI for analytics is desirable.
* Intermediate/Advanced Experience with MS SQL is a strong advantage. Ability to build/design and manipulate queries to improve process.
* Familiarity with another programming language such as VBA, .NET, R, Python is an advantage.

**Asst. Manager - CAT Modeling**
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage catastrophe modeling projects, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery of client and business requirements.
* Review, validate, and approve exposure data, data scrubbing activities, quality checks, and model-ready datasets.
* Manage and mentor a team of catastrophe modeling analysts, providing technical guidance, training, and performance coaching.
* Oversee workload planning, resource allocation, and project prioritization to meet business objectives and service-level expectations.
* Drive data quality initiatives by identifying process gaps, implementing controls, and ensuring adherence to quality standards.
* Perform complex account, portfolio, and reinsurance analysis using catastrophe modeling platforms and internal tools.
* Collaborate with onshore stakeholders, underwriters, brokers, actuaries, and client teams to resolve data and modeling-related queries.
* Monitor project risks, track deliverables, and proactively communicate status, issues, and mitigation plans to management.
* Develop and enhance standard operating procedures, best practices, and process improvement initiatives.
* Review catastrophe model outputs, perform reasonability checks, and provide analytical insights to support business decisions.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, audit requirements, and data governance standards.
* Support transition activities, process documentation, knowledge management, and capability-building initiatives within the team.

**Skills and Experience:**

* 10+ years of experience in Catastrophe Modeling, exposure management, and insurance analytics.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience with catastrophe modeling platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or equivalent industry-standard tools.
* Proven expertise in exposure data review, data cleansing, financial validation, geo-coding, and portfolio quality assurance.
* Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing performance, and developing junior analysts.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables, stakeholders, and competing priorities.
* Excellent understanding of insurance and reinsurance concepts, policy structures, CAT modeling methodologies, and financial terms.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, and data analysis techniques.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience interacting with global stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience driving process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy and quality.

Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics/ Statistics/ Operations Research/ Actuarial Science

title: AI Manager
description:
**AI Manager**

**Location**

Gurugram (Udyog Vihar Phase III), on-site; occasional travel to project sites

**Reports To -**
Head of IT

**Experience -**
7 to 10 years

**Employment Type -**
Full-time, permanent

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Most companies are still debating AI. We have decided to build it into how we engineer, bid, deliver and operate. WOG is looking for its first AI Manager to lead AI transformation and implementation across the company - deciding where AI goes to work, building it, and making sure it is adopted safely.

You will not be one voice in a large digital team. You will own the AI agenda end to end, with direct access to the CEO and leadership, and real engineering problems to solve - in water, wastewater and green energy.

**ABOUT WOG**

WOG Technologies is an IP-led engineering and technology company in water, wastewater and green energy, with 190+ projects delivered across 20+ countries and 350+ engineers. The group includes Bell Cooling Towers and the WOG Green Energy businesses - Green Coal, Carbon Loops, BESS, CBG and Carbon Credits. We are building a patent portfolio and a technology-first culture, and AI is central to that.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Set the AI agenda**

* Map how work flows across the business - proposals and bids, design and engineering, procurement, project delivery, plant operations and support functions - and find where AI saves the most time and money.
* Build and own a 12-month AI roadmap with a business case for every use case, and report the value delivered.

**Get the data ready**

* Organise the data AI depends on - document repositories, master data, and HR, finance and project records - so that AI answers are accurate and traceable.
* Set data ownership and quality standards with each function, starting with the data behind the first use cases.

**Build and ship AI solutions**

* Deploy enterprise AI tools - LLM assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation - and integrate them with our HRMS, ERP, Microsoft 365 and document systems.
* Design and deploy agentic AI: agents that carry out multi-step work across our systems, such as preparing tender responses, reconciling vendor quotes or compiling management reports, with people approving the key decisions.
* Automate high-effort work such as tender review, BOQ and estimation support, document control and management reporting.
* Explore AI for plant performance: predictive maintenance, process optimisation and remote monitoring.

**Make AI safe to use**

* Move WOG from restricted AI use to governed adoption: approved enterprise tools, a clear AI usage policy, and no company data in unapproved platforms.
* Configure data loss prevention (Microsoft Purview DLP) and sensitivity labels so AI tools see only what they should.
* Control what AI agents can access and do: least-privilege permissions, human approval for consequential actions, and full logging.
* Assess AI vendors for security, privacy and contractual risk; keep AI use compliant with the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000.

**Bring people along**

* Train employees and leaders to use AI well, and build a library of approved prompts, templates and agents.
* Work hand in hand with the IT team, which runs infrastructure and cyber security.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer applications or a related discipline.
* 7 to 10 years in technology, digital transformation or engineering roles, including hands-on generative AI work since late 2022.
* AI work you can show us: at least two AI solutions taken to production in an organisation, with measurable results.
* Working knowledge of Python, APIs and low-code automation, and of data protection in Microsoft 365 (DLP, sensitivity labels, access controls).
* An AI certification or programme from a reputed institute (IIT, IISc, IIM, ISB or a global equivalent) or a recognised vendor (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS).
* Interest in engineering businesses, with understanding of the water and wastewater industry or a willingness to learn it quickly.

**Good to have**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
* A cyber security certification - CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-401 / SC-300.
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (multi-step agents with tool access) in production.
* Postgraduate degree in AI, Machine Learning or Data Science.
* Experience in engineering, infrastructure, utilities, energy or manufacturing companies.

If you meet most of the must-haves and have shipped real AI work, apply. We hire for proven ability, not a perfect checklist.

**WHY WOG**

* Build it, don't maintain it: you are the first person in this role and shape how a whole company works.
* Direct line to leadership: your roadmap goes to the CEO, not through layers.
* Real-world impact and a broad canvas: water, wastewater and five green energy businesses.

* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI agents using AI Refinery, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, and custom agentic architectures.
* Build intelligent multi-agent systems capable of reasoning, planning, task decomposition, collaboration, and autonomous execution.
* Develop reusable agent orchestration frameworks, AI accelerators, and enterprise AI components.
* Design and implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations enabling seamless communication between AI agents and enterprise applications.
* Design Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows where business approvals or validations are required.
* Build AI copilots, autonomous agents, and workflow automation solutions for enterprise use cases.

**LLM Engineering & AI Model Development**

* Build, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize Large Language Models (LLMs) for enterprise use cases.
* Develop Generative AI applications using advanced prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and tool calling.
* Evaluate AI models across accuracy, latency, grounding quality, safety, hallucination rates, and business KPIs.
* Optimize prompts, agent workflows, and reasoning strategies to improve reliability and performance.
* Implement model evaluation pipelines and continuous improvement mechanisms.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**

* Design and implement enterprise RAG solutions using Azure AI Search, vector databases, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval techniques.
* Develop document ingestion, chunking, metadata enrichment, indexing, and retrieval pipelines.
* Optimize grounding strategies and retrieval quality to improve AI response accuracy.
* Build scalable enterprise knowledge management solutions powered by LLMs.

**Enterprise AI Integration**

* Integrate AI agents with ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft Teams, Splunk, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, and REST APIs.
* Build secure MCP integrations enabling AI agents to interact with enterprise systems.
* Develop scalable enterprise automation workflows leveraging AI agent orchestration.
* Design resilient API integrations with security, authentication, logging, retries, and error handling.

**AI Governance, Evaluation & Observability**

* Implement AI guardrails, Responsible AI principles, governance controls, and compliance standards.
* Design evaluation frameworks for measuring AI quality, grounding, latency, hallucination rates, and business outcomes.
* Build observability dashboards to monitor AI agent execution, token consumption, workflow performance, cost, and operational health.
* Ensure enterprise AI applications meet organizational security, governance, and compliance requirements.

**Solution Engineering & Deployment**

* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and engineering teams to design and deliver scalable cloud-native AI solutions.
* Deploy AI applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, and enterprise cloud platforms.
* Participate in architecture, design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and MLOps practices for AI solution lifecycle management.

**Innovation & Knowledge Sharing**

* Stay updated with advancements in Generative AI, Agentic AI, MCP, LLMs, and enterprise AI technologies.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, templates, and best practices.

Create technical documentation and mentor junior team members

title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
**The Short Version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage — and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. You’re someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real-world validation.

**What the role is about:**
At Kraftshala, you’ll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You’ll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.

**What makes this role meaningful:**
Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, you’ll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.

**Why you should apply:**

* ***Build things that actually get used —***
  products, tools, workflows, and automations that solve real problems for students and teams at Kraftshala.
* ***Go from idea to working solution fast —***
  use AI and modern development tools to prototype, test, and ship instead of waiting around for long development cycles.
* ***Own problems, not just tasks —***
  take an idea from identifying the problem to building the solution and seeing what impact it creates.
* ***Work on problems that matter —***
  across student experience, revenue, and internal operations, alongside product, engineering, and business teams.
* ***Get to build across the stack —***
  from understanding users and business problems to prototyping, testing, and shipping solutions with AI and modern technology.

If you’re someone who sees a problem and immediately wants to figure out how to build a better way, this role is for you.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest higher-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, you’ll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

You’ll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation — using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, you’ll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.

A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation — using AI-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.

**What you’ll own:**

* Find & Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what’s causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
* Build & Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
* Test & Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
* Ship & Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Delivery speed, adoption, business impact

**How you’ll operate:**

* You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
* You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
* You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
* You’re comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
* You prioritize speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features
* You care about what happens after something is built — adoption, impact, and outcomes

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**

* Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala’s users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
* Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement

**Month 2:**

* Own a problem from understanding to solution
* Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
* Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement

**Month 3+:**

* Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
* Run faster build-test-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real-world feedback
* Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency

**Must Haves:**

* 1–2 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role — startup experience is a plus. (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Have built and shipped something — a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, APIs, automation, no-code/low-code, or modern development tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving contexts.
* Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.

**Selection Process:**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes.

**Setting Expectations:**
This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.

**Technical Exercise:**
This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role

**Conversation 1:**
This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.

**Conversation 2:**
A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.

**Extending an offer:**
If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

**Location:**

Delhi

Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

description:

title: Remote Pod Lead - Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.

In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Remote Pod Lead - Life Science
description:

**About the Role:**

* Provide clear, actionable written feedback and track revisions through closure.
* Onboard and mentor trainers.
* Allocate work, track quality and throughput, and escalate blockers.
* Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks.

**About Innefu Labs**

Founded in 2010, Innefu Labs is an AI-driven R&D organisation focused on advanced Data Analytics and Information Security solutions. With 100+ successful deployments across the Indian Subcontinent, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia, Innefu has established a strong presence in AI for National and Cyber Security. Innefu specialises in building secure, high-performance products for sensitive and mission-critical environments, with a strong focus on innovation, reliability, scalability, and customer satisfaction

**Role Overview:**
Makes the robot walk, climb and recover on mud, rock, snow and stairs — designing and training the gait controller in simulation and transferring it to the real robot.

**Experience:**
3–8 years,

**Education:**
MTech/PhD with a thesis on legged locomotion. BTech/MTech/PhD in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics or Control Systems. Very few people in India have built legged robots, so a strong humanoid, exoskeleton or legged-research background also counts.

* Write state estimation (body pose and velocity) from IMU and joint sensors.
* Specify actuator and leg requirements to choose the off-the-shelf supplier.

**Must have**

* C++ and Python.
* Rigid-body dynamics and control theory: MPC, whole-body control, or RL for locomotion (PPO).
* At least one physics simulator: Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, PyBullet, Gazebo or RaiSim.
* Has run a controller on real robot hardware, not only in simulation.

**Good to have**

* Open-source legged stacks: legged\_gym, OCS2, Pinocchio, Drake, Crocoddyl.
* Publications at ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS or Humanoids.
* Kalman filters / state estimation; terrain-aware foothold planning.
* PyTorch, GPU training, domain randomisation.

title: Technology Specialist
company: Centre for Social and Behaviour Change
description:
**Job Title:**

Technology Specialist, System 3, CSBC

**Reports to:**

Dr Pavan Mamidi, Principal Investigator, System 3

**Location:**

Bengaluru

**Experience (in years):**

4 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience

**Nature of work:**

Full-time, one-year contract, renewable

**About Ashoka University**

Ashoka University is India’s premier interdisciplinary teaching and research university. An institution that has become a beacon of academic excellence in less than 10 years since its inception. At Ashoka, we encourage you to embrace the new, push the boundaries for continuous learning, and adapt to a world of constant change because we believe that each Ashokan is capable of becoming a thought leader.

As part of our thriving and committed workforce, you will:

**Be Mission-Driven:**

Champion interdisciplinary learning, innovative pedagogy, and academic rigor to transform Indian higher education.

**Think Strategically:**

Collaborate with visionary minds to shape the future of higher education through strategic planning and a forward-thinking approach.

**Act Authentically:**

Embrace authenticity and integrity, fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where every voice is valued.

**Take Accountability:**

Own your work and drive positive change, as an empowering individual seeking to make a meaningful contribution.

**Build Collaboration:**

Experience the power of teamwork and diverse perspectives, working collectively towards our shared goals.

**Deliver Excellence:**

Strive for excellence in all aspects, upholding the highest standards of academic excellence, student support, and professional development opportunities.

At Ashoka University, we are on a mission to redefine higher education and create a remarkable space where innovation and collaboration thrive. As a
**pioneering force in interdisciplinary learning**

, we
**continually grow and adapt**

to stay at the forefront of educational excellence with emphasis on inclusivity and equal opportunity. Our philosophy revolves around
**care, well-being, and connection**

, which are deeply embedded in everything we do.

**About the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change**

At the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC), we bring together behavioural scientists, policy experts, and researchers to develop novel insights and catalyse action. We partner with governments, non-profits, and corporations to embed behavioural science in programme design, creating solutions that work in practice and at scale. Established by Ashoka University with Gates Foundation support, we make development more people-centric through real-world applications of behavioural science. In recent years, CSBC researchers have contributed 25 peer-reviewed articles to top journals, advancing the nation’s behavioural evidence base and catalysing collaborations with leading institutions such as the University of Chicago, Yale School of Management, the University of Michigan, the Collegio Carlo Alberto, and Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. For more information, please visit
https://csbc.org.in/
.

**About System 3**

System 3 is a new research lab under the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change (CSBC). It will rest on two pillars.

**Basic science, from India:**

Most of what the world knows about how people think, trust and decide comes from a few narrow populations. India, with its range of languages, identities and institutions, is where those claims can be properly tested. We will run foundational, curiosity-driven research on cognition, judgement and behaviour, to learn which findings travel and which were only ever local. We take inspiration from the MIT Media Lab: open, accessible and joyful in the pursuit of credible science.

**AI and Behaviour:**

System 1 and System 2 describe the fast and slow thinking of the human mind, both shaped by the social and institutional worlds around us. System 3 will ask what happens to that mind in the age of AI. How do we learn, judge, trust and decide when intelligent machines are part of everyday life? What do we gain, and what do we quietly give away? This will be a major focus of our research agenda.

The two pillars will reinforce each other. Understanding the human mind in all its diversity will let us study how AI changes it.

We are a small team, early in our journey, based in Bengaluru. We are looking for people who like building something from scratch, who take ownership without waiting to be asked, and who are as comfortable rolling up their sleeves as thinking big. 

**Role and Responsibilities**

System 3 is hiring a Technology Specialist to build the technical foundations of its research on human behaviour and AI. The Technology Specialist will design and build the systems where people work with AI, so that we can measure how it changes the way they think, trust and decide. The role suits an engineer who wants their work to answer scientific questions, and who enjoys building something new in a small, ambitious team. Reporting to Dr Pavan Mamidi, the Technology Specialist will work directly with the Principal Investigators who lead our AI research and will see their work used in studies as soon as they start.

**What the Technology Specialist will do:**

**1. Build AI-interaction testbeds**

* Build instrumented environments where people work with AI agents and chatbots, capturing interaction traces, timing and behaviour.
* Link these systems to other measures, such as eye-tracking and pupillometry.
* Work with the Principal Investigators to turn research questions into systems that can run studies.

**2. Run the research data infrastructure**

* Set up secure data collection, storage and de-identification.
* Build and maintain data pipelines, automation and version control.
* Set up and look after the lab’s computing equipment.

**3. Keep the lab
*open***

* Maintain the lab’s public repository of code, instruments and replication packages.
* Write documentation that lets other researchers reproduce our work.

**4. Build prototypes in the Garage**

* Build software tools and interfaces in our Behavioural Design and Prototyping Garage, our workshop for making research instruments and tools. Examples include deepfake-detection training and scenario engines for low-literacy, multilingual users.
* Show working builds at regular demo days.
* Bring in outside specialists when a build needs hardware.

**Qualifications and Skills Required**

Qualifications

* 4 to 5 years of professional software or data engineering experience.

Technical Skills

*Required*

* Building and deploying software in a professional setting, with Python and web applications.
* Working with LLM and agent APIs, including logging their inputs and outputs.
* Databases, and secure handling of sensitive data.
* Version control, testing and documentation.

*Desirable*

* Online experiment tools such as jsPsych, oTree or lab.js.
* Instrumenting user interaction (logging and telemetry).
* Research or academic lab experience.
* Offline-first or mobile applications.
* Open-source contributions.
* Data privacy and compliance.

Professional Skills

* Enjoys turning a scientist’s question into a working system, and explaining technical choices to non-engineers.
* Takes ownership and works independently.
* Curiosity about how people think and decide, and about how AI changes it.
* A preference for flat teams, where a good idea counts for more than a title.
* Clear writing and good documentation habits.
* Willingness to do whatever a research start-up needs, from fixing a study at short notice to setting up equipment for a public talk.

**Application Submission Process**

We invite you to embark on this journey by submitting your application to the Centre for Social and Behaviour Change. To ensure your candidacy receives the attention it deserves, kindly follow the application submission process outlined below:

**Prepare Your Materials:**

Please put together the following.

* **An updated CV:**

  Showcase your professional accomplishments, skills, and experiences.
* **A concise cover letter:**

  In no more than one page, explain why you are applying and which of your skills you expect to rely on in your first week and your first month on the job.
* **A link to your work:**

  Share a link to your code or projects (GitHub or similar), with a short note on one project you are proud of. Please be ready to discuss it at the interview.
* **A professional referee:**

  The name and email address of a manager or colleague who can speak to your work (a professional, not an academic, reference). We will contact referees only after screening CVs, so please let them know we may be in touch.

**Submit Your Application:**

Email your materials to
careersatcsbc@ashoka.edu.in
, ensuring the subject line reads as follows: “Tech Specialist\_System 3\_<Applicant Name>”. Make sure your surname is included in the titles of all attachments. This will help us efficiently process your application.

**Include Essential Details:**

Along with your materials, kindly provide the following information:

* Last compensation received: We value your expertise and acknowledge the importance of fair compensation.
* Expected salary: Share your aspirations for growth and remuneration.
* Notice period: Inform us of the time required to transition from your current role, if applicable.

**Pursuit of Excellence:**

At Ashoka University, we strive for excellence in all aspects of our operations. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted as part of our rigorous selection process.

**Adherence to Deadlines:**

Applications should be submitted by
**15 November 2026, 5:00 pm IST**

. While late applications will not be considered, eligible applications may be reviewed and shortlisted on a rolling basis prior to the deadline.

We look forward to receiving your application as we embark together on a remarkable journey of professional growth and development. Join our exceptional community at Ashoka University, where excellence is nurtured, and aspirations are transformed into reality.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This position works as a member of an Agile/scrum software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal software systems. A senior engineer is a senior role in Software Agile delivery team. The person is responsible for managing and executing the complex software modules almost independently. Additionally, the indvidual is responsible of guding and mentoring junior engineers in the team from technology standpoint.

title: Manager - Fraud Prevention
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organizations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager in our AI driven Fraud prevention practice. You will shape the strategy, solutions and delivery of AI-driven fraud detection and prevention for banks, payments companies, lenders, insurers and fintechs.

This is a senior role that combines deep fraud domain expertise, hands-on technical credibility, client leadership and team building. You will own our fraud AI offerings end-to-end, from client conversations and solution design through to models running in production and delivering measurable reductions in fraud losses.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead client engagements end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through model development, deployment and value realization.
* Be the SME and guide delivery of use cases such as card and payments fraud, application and identity fraud, synthetic identities, account takeover, first-party fraud, authorized push payment (APP) scams and mule account detection but using new age AI techniques including graph-based reasoning and transformer architectures.
* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for Sirius AI’s Fraud prevention AI offerings, including solution accelerators, reusable assets and product capabilities.
* Guide the team on modelling approaches including supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, transformer-based models, behavioral and device signals, agentic AI implementations and real-time scoring.
* Ensure client delivery use cases meet MRM and regulatory specs for explainability, validation and ongoing monitoring.
* Build, mentor and lead a high-performing team of data scientists, AI engineers ML engineers and analysts; set technical standards and contribute to hiring.
* Support business development through proposals, solution demonstrations, proofs of concept and client presentations, and help grow existing accounts.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative field; a PhD or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics or AI, including at least 3 years focused on fraud, financial crime or risk in financial services.
* A proven track record of taking fraud models into production and delivering measurable business impact.
* Deep understanding of fraud typologies, the fraud lifecycle and fraud operations, including alerting, investigation, case management and chargebacks.
* Strong grounding in machine learning (gradient boosting, neural networks, anomaly detection, graph methods) and working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review and challenge the team’s technical work.
* Familiarity with fraud platforms and data sources such as FICO Falcon, NICE Actimize, Feature space or SAS Fraud Management, and with device, identity and consortium data.
* 3+ years of experience leading teams, and confidence managing senior stakeholders
* Consulting or client-facing experience, including solution selling, pre-sales and engagement management.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

**Good to Have**

* Experience delivering fraud solutions across multiple geographies, such as the US, UK, Europe or SE Asia.
* Hands-on exposure to real-time streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink) and cloud ML platforms

description:

The Innovation Engineer rapidly turns high-value business opportunities into working Digital & AI solutions. This hands-on role designs, builds, integrates, and tests prototypes, agents, workflows, automations, and applications that can be evaluated with real users before the firm commits to larger-scale investment.

Working closely with Digital Solution Consultants, business subject-matter experts, and enterprise technology partners, the Innovation Engineer owns the technical execution of individual Foundry initiatives, from technical discovery and architecture through prototype development, iteration, feasibility validation, and transition planning. The role balances speed with sound engineering judgment and helps determine whether a concept can be delivered securely, responsibly, and at the appropriate level of scale.

This position also represents a unique opportunity to join as a founding member of our new Digital Innovation Foundry hub in New Delhi. As one of the hub's earliest team members, the Innovation Engineer will have the opportunity to help establish how the team operates, collaborates, and delivers innovative solutions while contributing to the growth of a new strategic capability for the firm.

J.S. Held is continuing to define the development technology stack, cloud patterns, environments, and CI/CD capabilities needed to support innovation at scale. As an early member of the Digital Innovation Foundry, the Innovation Engineer will partner closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Data, and other technology teams to help shape practical standards, reusable patterns, development environments, and delivery practices. The role requires a builder mindset, strong cloud development experience, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to distinguish rapid experimentation from production-ready engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Rapid Prototyping & Solution Development**

* Build functional prototypes, proofs of concept, agents, workflows, automations, integrations, and lightweight applications that allow opportunities to be tested with real users.
* Translate business problems, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria into practical technical solutions in close partnership with Digital Solution Consultants.
* Use rapid, iterative development methods to incorporate user feedback and improve functionality, reliability, and usability.
* Select fit-for-purpose technologies and patterns for each experiment while considering speed, security, supportability, reuse, and the likely path to scale.
* Document technical assumptions, architecture decisions, dependencies, known limitations, and lessons learned so that decisions are transparent and reusable.
* Demonstrate working solutions to business and technical stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs in clear, decision-oriented language.

**AI, Agents & Automation Engineering**

* Build reusable components, connectors, templates, and patterns where they can accelerate multiple initiatives and reduce fragmented point solutions.
* Identify when a low-code, configuration-based, custom-development, or existing-platform approach is most appropriate.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

* Design and develop cloud-based solutions in Microsoft Azure.

* Partner with IT and Enterprise Architecture to define appropriate solution patterns and clarify the boundary between rapid Foundry experimentation and enterprise production delivery.

* Contribute technical estimates and delivery options to initiative-level business cases and scale decisions.

* Implement monitoring, logging, usage telemetry, and cost visibility where appropriate to support evaluation and future supportability.
