title: Robotics Reinforcement Learning Engineer (Reinforcement Learning/ Sim2Real)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Robotics Reinforcement Learning Engineer**
to develop and deploy reinforcement learning-based locomotion policies for autonomous quadruped robots.
  
  
In this role, you will train robotic systems to maintain dynamic balance, respond to physical disturbances, and navigate different terrain conditions. You will use physics-based simulation and reinforcement learning to develop robust control policies, then transfer and validate those policies on physical robotic hardware.
  
  
The role combines reinforcement learning, legged robot locomotion, simulation engineering, and real-time deployment, with a strong emphasis on improving reliability when moving from simulation to real-world operation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop reinforcement learning-based locomotion policies using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or comparable simulation platforms.
* Train parallelized locomotion policies across randomized terrain, friction conditions, and dynamic disturbances.
* Develop blind and vision-assisted locomotion approaches for quadruped robots operating in different environments.
* Implement domain randomization across physical parameters, including friction, motor latency, payload variations, and mass distribution.
* Improve Sim-to-Real transfer to ensure learned policies remain stable and effective when deployed on physical robots.
* Implement and optimize reinforcement learning algorithms, including PPO, using Python, PyTorch, and related tools.
* Deploy trained policies using C++, ONNX Runtime, LibTorch, or other suitable inference frameworks.
* Optimize neural policy inference for high-frequency robotic control and low-latency execution.
* Integrate foot-contact estimation, slip detection, and reflex mechanisms to improve stability and reduce the risk of joint damage.
* Test and evaluate locomotion performance in simulation and on physical quadruped platforms.
* Analyze control failures, investigate performance gaps between simulation and hardware, and implement iterative improvements.
* Work closely with robotics controls, simulation, and embedded systems engineers to support integrated robot autonomy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Control Systems, or a related field.
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in reinforcement learning, robot learning, locomotion control, or autonomous robotics.
* Strong Python programming skills and practical experience with PyTorch.
* Experience training reinforcement learning policies, particularly using PPO or similar algorithms.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, MuJoCo, or other physics-based robotics simulators.
* Understanding of legged robot dynamics, locomotion control, dynamic balance, or contact-rich robotic systems.
* Practical knowledge of domain randomization and Sim-to-Real transfer techniques.
* Experience with C++ and deploying learned models on robotic hardware or edge platforms.
* Familiarity with ONNX Runtime, LibTorch, or comparable inference frameworks is an advantage.
* Knowledge of contact estimation, slip handling, motor dynamics, or real-time control is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to validate reinforcement learning policies through systematic testing and experimentation.

**Why Join?**

* Work on advanced robotic autonomy and reinforcement learning technologies.
* Develop locomotion policies that enable quadruped robots to handle complex and unpredictable terrain.
* Gain hands-on exposure to simulation-to-hardware deployment and real-world robotics challenges.
* Collaborate with specialists across robot learning, motion control, and embedded systems.
* Contribute to practical R&D projects focused on improving robotic stability, adaptability, and autonomy.

**Work Location & Arrangement**
On-site at the robotics R&D facility in New Delhi, India

title: Applied AI Architect
description:

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
**Title:**
Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)

**Location:**
Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.

**Salary:**
Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.

**Position:**
Full-time

**Application deadline:**
Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)

**About the Role**

Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.

The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.

If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.

We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.

**Responsibilities**

These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.

**Formative Research**

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

**Use Case Definition & Design**

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

**Data & Analysis**

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes

* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

**How to Apply**

To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.

In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.

**About Precision Development (PxD)**

PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.

Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Founding AI Engineer, Platform

About Effi Flo

Effi Flo is a tech enablement firm for staffing and recruitment agencies. We use AI and automation to run their workflows end to end, and we help some clients hire directly. Our clients are in North America and Europe. We are bootstrapped and profitable.

We have spent the last few years building custom systems for our clients. Now we are turning that work into one platform, and clients already pay for it.

Our goal is for every staffing and recruitment agency to run as an AI-native business. Shopify let any shop sell online. We want to give agencies the same jump.

What you will build

You will own the technical side of the platform, from architecture to production. The work covers:

* AI agents that take on research, matching and writing recruiters now do by hand
* Talent matching that ranks the right people for a role in minutes
* One clean view of every candidate and client, across the tools agencies use
* Timing and outreach: who to contact, when, and with what context
* Per-client setup, so each agency's own hiring method runs inside the product
* The web app recruiters and clients work in every day, from database to screen
* Evaluation and guardrails, so clients can trust what the AI produces
* Architecture, tool choices and standards for testing, monitoring and cost

What you will do with clients

You will spend real time with our clients, most of them in the US.

* Run technical discovery with agency founders and recruiters
* Design solutions and run proofs of concept on their own data
* Turn one-off client requests into platform features that serve every client

Expect roughly 60% building, 25% with clients, and 15% leading and planning. The mix will shift as the team grows.

How this role grows

You start as the first senior engineer on the platform and its technical lead. As the platform and client base grow, you hire and lead a small engineering team. You shape the roadmap with the Founder, so he can spend more time on sales and clients.

What we look for

* 8-12 years of production software, backend first, with frontend work shipped
* Strong Python, TypeScript, SQL and Postgres, with schemas that hold up for years
* Frontend: React or Next.js apps you built that people use every day
* AI in production: agents, retrieval (RAG), prompt design, evals and guardrails, plus cost and latency control, built on Claude, OpenAI or Gemini APIs
* You follow AI closely and know when a new model changes what we should build
* Data pipelines at scale: millions of records, many sources, messy inputs
* Solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design
* Comfort in front of clients: you can run a discovery call, explain trade-offs to a non-engineer and push back when a request is wrong
* Time on a founding team or early-stage startup, owning problems end to end
* High agency and self-driven: you do what needs doing without being asked
* High integrity: you flag what you don't know and own your mistakes

Nice to have

* Experience in sales tech, GTM tech or recruitment tech
* Supabase, pgvector, or serverless on AWS
* You use Claude Code or a similar tool daily to plan, write and review code
* You have mentored or led engineers
* You have built and shipped a product of your own

Our stack

Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Supabase (Postgres, pgvector), Claude and other LLM APIs, n8n, Data APIs, Render, Vercel, and a range of third-party APIs.

What we offer

* Competitive salary + meaningful equity (ESOP)
* A founding seat on a platform that clients already pay for
* Daily work with the Founder, who ran his own recruitment firm and spent a decade in startup leadership roles across India and North America
* US and European clients, and a team that works async across time zones
* A small team where your decisions ship

title: Applied Scientist
description:

Applied Scientist – Machine Learning

**Function:**
Machine Learning / Applied Science

**Location:**
Gurugram, India (Onsite)

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Information Technology & Services, Computer Software, Industrial Automation

**About Company**

An industrial AI startup using Causal AI to help semiconductor and manufacturing companies find and fix the root causes of equipment and process failures. The company's Causal Intelligence Platform integrates multimodal factory data with explainable causal reasoning — going beyond surface-level correlations.

It is seed-funded at $3M and backed by Capria Ventures and Endiya Partners. The team of 19 engineers brings deep expertise in semiconductor defect analysis, causal reasoning, and graph intelligence.

The company operates with high agency, low bureaucracy, and a real-world-first culture. Solutions are built for explainability and deployed in secure, private environments — co-developed closely with customers.

**Position Overview**

This role sits at the intersection of applied ML research and production engineering, directly shaping the scientific direction of the company's Causal Intelligence Platform. The Applied Scientist will design and ship ML systems that turn chaotic multimodal industrial data — time-series, logs, waveforms, and documents — into reliable root-cause insights used by engineers at semiconductor fabs, utilities, and advanced manufacturing lines. The work spans LLM/RAG pipelines, time-series diagnostics, and scalable multimodal ingestion, with direct influence on product architecture and customer outcomes.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design and develop ML algorithms for time-series, log, and waveform-based diagnostics across industrial datasets
* Build and optimize LLM/RAG pipelines including structured extraction, hybrid search, and domain-specific reasoning
* Architect scalable multimodal ingestion frameworks covering documents, logs, sensor streams, alarms, and images
* Productize ML models in collaboration with engineering teams into reliable, customer-facing systems
* Define use cases, benchmarks, and evaluation frameworks with product teams
* Lead ML projects end-to-end and contribute to patents, technical architecture documents, and research publications
* Prototype aggressively, iterate on real customer feedback, and own outcomes from research through deployment

**Must Have Criteria**

* BS/MS/PhD in AI/ML, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field
* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in ML research or applied ML roles
* Strong Python programming skills with a track record of building and scaling ML systems in production
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architecture, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning
* Demonstrated experience with time-series modeling, anomaly detection, or statistical signal processing
* Proven ability to take ML projects from experimentation to deployed, customer-facing systems

**Nice to Have**

**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.

Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.

Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.
  
  
Good to Have Skills
  
  
Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.
  
  
Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.

description:

Gurugram, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

**We've got your back...**

title: Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Synthetic Data & Teleoperation Engineer**
to build simulation environments, synthetic data pipelines, and teleoperation systems that support the development of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and robotic learning.
  
  
You will create realistic virtual environments for diverse security scenarios, develop systems for capturing robotic demonstrations, and manage datasets used to train and evaluate AI models. This role combines robotics simulation, 3D environment development, teleoperation hardware, and data engineering to help bridge the gap between simulated training and real-world robotic applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build synthetic data generation pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse for diverse scenarios, including night vision, perimeter breaches, and adverse weather conditions.
* Develop and maintain simulation environments that support robotic perception, planning, and manipulation tasks.
* Design, configure, and maintain VR-based teleoperation systems and hardware setups to capture high-quality demonstration trajectories for imitation learning.
* Integrate teleoperation interfaces and robotics simulation workflows using OpenXR and related technologies.
* Develop and maintain dataset curation, automated labeling, and data processing pipelines for robotic foundation model training.
* Organize and maintain structured, tokenized repositories of robotic demonstrations for training and evaluation.
* Use tools such as Blender and Unreal Engine to develop and refine realistic 3D environments and simulation assets.
* Evaluate simulation realism and identify visual discrepancies between simulated environments and real-world conditions.
* Benchmark and reduce Sim-to-Real domain gaps to improve the reliability of models trained on synthetic data.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to support VLA model development, imitation learning, and simulation-based experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Graphics, or a related field.
* Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in robotics simulation, synthetic data generation, teleoperation, 3D environment development, or related areas.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with C++.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Omniverse, or other robotics simulation platforms.
* Understanding of USD (Universal Scene Description) and simulation asset workflows.
* Experience with VR-based teleoperation, OpenXR, or hardware interfaces is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Blender, Unreal Engine, or other 3D content creation tools.
* Understanding of robotic demonstration collection, imitation learning, or robotics dataset preparation.
* Knowledge of synthetic data generation, automated labeling, domain randomization, or Sim-to-Real evaluation is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to build practical simulation and data pipelines.

**Why Join?**

* Work at the intersection of robotics simulation, synthetic data, and embodied AI.
* Build virtual environments and teleoperation systems that support real-world robotic learning.
* Contribute to the development of advanced AI systems using simulation-driven training and evaluation.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams working on robotics, foundation models, and intelligent perception.

title: Sr Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
Job Description — Solution Engineer (aka STS), CCaaS & Voice AI (Individual Contributor)
  
  
Company: Tata Communications
  
  
Function: Solution Engineering (aka STS) — Customer Interaction Suite
  
  
Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC) — no people management
  
  
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, or Gurugram (hybrid; on-site as per project needs)
  
  
Experience: 6–9 years in contact centre / cloud telephony / voice AI solution engineering
  
  
Travel: Up to 30% (client sites within India and occasional overseas)
  
  
**About The Role (a Note From The Hiring Head)**
Tata Communications is one of the world’s most interconnected digital infrastructure companies, built on our Digital Fabric that connects networks, cloud, and customer interactions for global enterprises. Within our customer experience portfolio, we sell and deliver cloud contact centre (CCaaS) and AI-driven engagement solutions end to end — including our InstaCC™ contact centre platform, the Smartflo CCaaS platform, and the Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS suite we acquired in 2023 (messaging, voice, video and chat APIs), alongside a global OEM ecosystem spanning Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone
  
  
Every enterprise deal we win now hinges on two things: a well-architected CCaaS solution and a compelling Voice AI story — voice bots, IVR transformation, speech-enabled self-service, and agent-assist. I am looking for a hands-on Solution Engineer who lives in that intersection: someone who can take a customer’s call-flow diagram and turn it into a winning, priced, demonstrable solution.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Pre-sales and Solution Design
  
  

* Own the technical win in the sales cycle: conduct discovery workshops with enterprise customers, document their current contact centre estate (telephony, routing, IVR, CRM, WFM, analytics), and translate business requirements into a target-state CCaaS + Voice AI architecture.
* Design end-to-end solutions across our portfolio — InstaCC, Smartflo, and Kaleyra CCaaS/CPaaS — and across OEM platforms (Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect, Webex Contact Centre, NICE CXone, Five9), including telephony integration (SIP trunking, WebRTC, SBCs), channel routing (voice, chat, WhatsApp, email), and CRM/helpdesk integration.
* Architect the Voice AI components specifically: conversational IVR and voice bots, ASR/STT and TTS selection, NLU and LLM-driven dialogue design, barge-in, DTMF fallbacks, latency and WER budgets, and clear escalation to human agents.

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept
  
  

* Build and maintain compelling demos that showcase CCaaS workflows and Voice AI behaviours (voice bot conversations, sentiment detection, agent-assist) that our sales teams can take into customer rooms.
* Scope, build, and run PoCs with customers; define success criteria (containment, deflection, CSAT impact) and deliver crisp readouts.

RFPs, RFIs and Commercial Support
  
  

* Lead the technical portions of RFPs/RFIs and solution defence presentations; write the technical response, solution narrative, and architecture diagrams.
* Support commercials: build bill-of-materials, platform sizing, voice/AI consumption estimates, and effort/cost inputs for SOW and pricing decisions — while keeping the solution technically honest.

Partner and Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Work closely with our platform partners (Genesys, Amazon, Webex, and others) on roadmap access, licensing nuances, and joint solutioning for large deals.
* Validate third-party and our own AI component choices (speech engines, LLM-based voice agents, analytics) against real customer use cases.

Implementation Handoff and Feedback
  
  

* Hand over won deals to delivery/implementation teams with clean solution documentation; join the first design reviews to ensure what was sold is what gets built.
* Feed market learnings — what wins, what doesn’t, what customers ask for — back into our product and portfolio teams.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable)
  
  

* CCaaS depth — 6+ years designing, demonstrating, or deploying contact centre solutions on at least one leading platform (Genesys Cloud/CX, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Five9, Avaya, Webex CC) and a working command of cloud telephony: SIP, PRI/trunking, WebRTC, SBCs, DTMF, call recording, and omni-channel routing.
* Voice AI expertise — Demonstrable experience designing and delivering voice AI / conversational AI solutions: IVR and voice-bot design, ASR/STT and TTS engines (e.g., Azure Speech, Google STT, Amazon Transcribe/Polly), NLU and/or LLM-driven dialogue flows, barge-in and error handling, and real-world tuning for accuracy (WER), latency, and containment.
* Solution engineering craft — Proven track record in pre-sales: discovery, solution architecture, demos, PoCs, RFP/RFI responses, BoM and pricing support.
* India market context — Understanding of India’s telecom/enterprise landscape relevant to voice workloads: carrier numbering and provisioning practices, TRAI/DoT compliance considerations, and how enterprise contact centres buy telephony in India.
* Communication — Ability to explain architecture to CIOs and call flows to operations heads; comfortable presenting and debating in customer rooms; excellent written technical documentation.

Good to Have
  
  

* Exposure to CPaaS APIs (messaging, voice, WhatsApp) — experience with Kaleyra or similar is a plus.
* CRM and ecosystem integration knowledge (Salesforce, MS Dynamics, helpdesk platforms).
* Working knowledge of speech analytics, sentiment analysis, real-time agent-assist, and LLM-based voice agents.
* Relevant certifications (Genesys, AWS Connect, Google/cloud speech services, etc.).
* Experience with managed services or telco hosting models in the CCaaS space.

What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
  
  

* Technical win rate on supported opportunities; number of deals where our solution architecture and demos were decisive.
* PoC success rate and time-to-PoC.
* Quality and completeness of RFP responses and solution documentation (on-time, high first-pass accuracy).
* Accuracy of solution/BOM estimates versus won contract scope.
* Customer and internal stakeholder feedback (sales, delivery, partners).

description:
**Role: Principal AI Engineer, Semantic Layer (R&D Lead)**

**Type:**
Full-time · Core Platform Team

**Location:**
Delhi NCR (immediate joiners preferred)

**Experience:**
5-7 years total · 2-3+ years in production AI/ML systems

**Reports to:**
CTO

**ABOUT SUTRA.AI**

Sutra.AI is an AI transformation platform purpose-built for mid-market businesses, teams that want enterprise-grade AI outcomes without building a large AI organization. The platform orchestrates end-to-end:

data → opportunities → projects → production apps/APIs, with value tracking built in.

We've been building for 3+ years, launched out of stealth recently, and already have dozens of customers with millions of dollars in measurable ROI. We're in scale-up mode - shipping fast, standardizing platform engineering patterns that compound across every customer and product line.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**We're hiring a Principal AI Engineer (R&D Lead) to own the execution of our AI systems end-to-end.**

This is the execution backbone of our AI platform. You'll architect and ship production systems, set engineering standards, and work directly with founders on high-priority initiatives. You'll turn ambiguous problems into scalable solutions, independently, with minimal oversight.

**This is not a research role. Not a coordination role. This is a builder + owner role.**

The systems you build will be used by the entire team. The patterns you establish will be replicated across the organization. High-leverage by design.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

• Design and implement production AI systems: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, LLM orchestration,

evaluation harnesses

• Own the full lifecycle: problem scoping → prototyping → production deployment → monitoring and iteration

• Build scalable backend systems in Python - APIs, async workflows, data pipelines

• Establish engineering standards and best practices across the AI platform

• Lead execution across junior engineers: code reviews, unblocking, technical guidance

• Set up evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability

• Debug complex issues across layers: data quality, model behavior, infrastructure, system design

• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, founders, and customers on roadmap and technical decisions

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must-Haves**

• B.Tech (CS) Degree from IIT

• 5-7 years total software engineering experience

• 2-3+ years building production AI/ML systems (not just research or experiments)

• Strong backend engineering skills: Python, APIs, async systems, distributed architectures

• Proven track record of end-to-end ownership - shipped systems independently from idea to production

• LLM systems: RAG, prompting, agents, evaluation, embeddings, retrieval

• LLM orchestration: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent

• Cloud AI platforms: AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent

• Vector databases and retrieval systems: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or similar

• Data pipelines: ETL, batch/stream processing

• System design and scalability thinking - build for production, not local prototypes

• Strong analytical and debugging skills: root cause analysis, not quick fixes

• Team-oriented mindset: mentor others, prioritize company impact, low ego

**Preferred**

• Experience from high-ownership environments: startups or fast-moving product companies

• LLM fine-tuning or training experience

• Familiarity with data platforms: Trino, Spark, Airflow, dbt

• Open-source contributions or published technical writing

**WHY JOIN US**

•
**High ownership: own systems end-to-end without constant oversight**

• High leverage: everything you build gets reused; every pattern you set gets replicated

• Core team: direct impact on company direction and technical decisions

• Hard problems: build production AI systems at scale, not demos

• Early stage: shape the engineering culture, tech stack, and product direction

title: Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems)**
**Role Summary**
As the Lead AI Engineer (Agentic Systems), you will help architect and build the organization’s next generation of autonomous AI workflows. This is a multidisciplinary technical role operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering. You will move beyond simple "chatbots" to design production-grade Agentic Systems: intelligent applications capable of reasoning, planning, and executing complex tasks autonomously.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agentic Systems Architecture & Core Engineering**

* Architect & Build Multi-Agent Workflows: Lead the hands-on design and coding of stateful, production-grade agentic systems using Python and orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication: Design and implement robust A2A protocols enabling autonomous agents to collaborate, hand off sub-tasks, and negotiate execution paths dynamically within multi-agent environments.
* State Management & Orchestration: Engineer robust control flows for non-deterministic agents; implement complex message passing, memory persistence, and interruptible state handling to support long-running autonomous tasks.
* Tool Interface Design (MCP): Implement and standardize the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create universal interfaces between agents, data sources, and operational tools, ensuring modularity and scalability.
* Model Integration & Optimization: Utilize proxy services (i.e. LiteLLM) to manage model routing and fallback strategies; optimize context windows and inference costs across proprietary and open-source models.
* Production Deployment: Containerize agentic workloads using Docker and orchestrate deployments on Kubernetes; leverage AWS AgentCore or similar cloud-native services for scalable infrastructure.

**Data Engineering & Operational Real-Time Integration**

* Build Agent Data Pipelines: Write and maintain high-throughput ingestion pipelines (using Databricks or Python-based ETL) that transform raw operational signals into structured context for agents.
* Real-Time Context Injection: Ensure agents have access to "operational real-time" data (seconds/minutes latency) by optimizing retrieval architectures and vector store performance.
* Cross-Functional Engineering: Act as the technical bridge between Data Engineering and AI teams; translate complex agent requirements into concrete data schemas and pipeline specifications, while stepping in to resolve hands-on bottlenecks in data availability.

**Observability, Governance & Human-in-the-Loop**

* LLMOps & Tracing: Implement comprehensive observability using tools like Langfuse to trace agent reasoning steps, monitor token usage, and debug latency issues in production.
* Safety & Control Frameworks: Design hybrid execution modes ranging from Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) for sensitive operations to fully autonomous execution; build "break-glass" mechanisms and guardrails for automated decision-making.
* Evaluation & Reliability: Establish technical standards for testing non-deterministic outputs; automate evaluation pipelines to measure agent accuracy, hallucination rates, and drift before deployment.

**Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* Technical Roadmap Definition: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to scope feasibility for autonomous projects; define the "Agentic Architecture" roadmap.
* Mentorship & Standards: Define code quality standards, architectural patterns, and PR review processes for the AI engineering team; upskill team members on the latest agentic frameworks and methodologies.
* Innovation: Proactively prototype with emerging tools (e.g., new reasoning models, graph-based RAG) to solve high-value business problems, moving successful experiments into the production roadmap.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Experience: 7+ years of total technical experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Machine Learning.
* GenAI Specialization: 2+ years of specific experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or Agentic Systems in production.
* Database & Lakehouse Mastery: Experience architecting storage layers for AI, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant), NoSQL/Relational Databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), and modern Data Lakehouses (specifically Databricks or Snowflake).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Expertise in cloud architecture and container orchestration (AWS, GCP, or Azure) using Kubernetes and Docker. You must be comfortable deploying and scaling your own applications.
* LLM Ecosystem: Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen). You understand the mechanics of RAG, embeddings, and context window management.
* Hybrid Engineering Skillset: A unique blend of Data Science (understanding model behavior, probability, and prompting) and Software Engineering (CI/CD, API design, asynchronous programming, and system reliability).
* Language Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python for systems engineering, capable of writing modular, testable, and maintainable production code.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.

**Preferred**

* Advanced Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* NLP Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), ranging from foundational techniques (e.g., text processing, embeddings, classification) to modern architectures.
* Graph Technologies: Experience with Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), Graph Databases, and GraphML (Graph Machine Learning) to support complex reasoning and relationship modeling.
* Agentic Tooling: Specific experience with LangGraph, LiteLLM, Langfuse, AWS AgentCore, or implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Advanced Architectures: Proven track record of implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication, swarm intelligence, or multi-modal agent workflows.
* Real-Time Operations: Experience working in environments requiring operational real-time processing (e.g., FinTech, Energy, Logistics).

**Why This Role Matters**
You won't just be building chatbots here; you will be architecting the organization’s "central nervous system." As the Lead AI Engineer for Agentic Systems, you are bridging the gap between static data models and active decision-making. The autonomous workflows you design—capable of planning, collaborating (A2A), and executing tasks—will fundamentally change how we operate, moving us from human-dependent processes to self-healing, intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to define the standards for Agentic AI in a production environment, working with a stack that represents the absolute cutting edge of the industry.
  
  
**About S&P Global Energy**
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at www.spglobal.com/energy.
  
  
**What’s In It For**

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We seek a motivated Junior Generative AI Developer to design, implement, and optimize cutting-edge generative AI solutions. You’ll work closely with senior engineers to build applications leveraging LLMs (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, Gemini), diffusion models, and multimodal systems while adhering to ethical AI practices. This will be a hands-on individual contributor role.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Model Development & Fine-Tuning**

* Assist in developing, training, and fine-tuning generative models (text, image, code) using frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
* Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and optimize prompts for specific domains.

1. **Tooling & Integration**

* Build applications using tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Integrate GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral) into enterprise workflows.

1. **Prompt Engineering**

* Design and test advanced prompting strategies (e.g., few-shot learning, chain-of-thought, ReAct frameworks) for domain-specific tasks (legal, healthcare, finance).
* Create reusable prompt templates for common workflows (customer support, code generation, content moderation).

1. **Evaluation & Optimization**

* Develop metrics for hallucination reduction, output consistency, and safety alignment.
* Optimize model inference costs using quantization, distillation, or speculative decoding.

1. **Collaboration**

* Work with cross-functional teams (product, data engineers, UX) to deploy AI solutions.
* Document technical processes and contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions.

**Qualifications**

* **Education**
  : Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field.
* **Technical Skills**
  :
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI/ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
* Basic understanding of NLP (tokenization, attention mechanisms) and neural architectures (Transformers, GANs).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure ML).

* **AI/GenAI Exposure and experience with at least two of the following:**
* Hands-on projects with LLMs (fine-tuning, prompt engineering) or diffusion models.

* Contributions to NLP projects (sentiment analysis, NER, text summarization) using libraries like spaCy or NLTK.

title: Multimodal AI Engineer (Robotics & Foundation Models)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Multimodal AI Engineer**
to develop and adapt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models for autonomous robotic systems. You will work at the intersection of multimodal perception, foundation models, and robotic learning, helping AI systems interpret visual inputs, plan complex tasks, and translate instructions into physical actions.
  
  
This role focuses on fine-tuning multimodal models, developing multi-camera perception pipelines, implementing action-generation architectures, and optimizing models for deployment on edge AI platforms. You will collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to turn research concepts into practical, high-performance AI capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, fine-tune, and adapt Vision Transformers (ViTs) and multimodal foundation models for robotic perception and action generation.
* Implement action-chunking architectures, including Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) and Diffusion Policy, to support long-horizon robotic task planning.
* Build multi-camera fusion pipelines that combine visual inputs into coherent representations for VLA perception and decision-making.
* Develop and optimize multimodal feature extraction pipelines that integrate visual perception with downstream robotic planning and action-generation systems.
* Integrate computer vision capabilities, including face recognition and perimeter threat assessment, into multimodal AI workflows.
* Apply parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques, including LoRA, to adapt foundation models for specific robotic applications.
* Work with Transformer architectures, visual embeddings, and vector search techniques to improve multimodal representation and information retrieval.
* Profile and optimize multimodal models through pruning and other model compression techniques to improve inference efficiency.
* Prepare and optimize model weights for downstream deployment using NVIDIA TensorRT and related inference optimization tools.
* Evaluate model performance through systematic experiments, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineering teams across VLA, robotics controls, and edge AI to support end-to-end system development.

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related field.
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in multimodal AI, deep learning, computer vision, foundation models, or robotic learning.
* Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
* Experience developing, training, or fine-tuning Transformer-based architectures, Vision Transformers, or multimodal deep learning models.
* Understanding of vision-language models, multimodal representation learning, and the integration of visual information into AI decision-making systems.
* Practical experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, such as LoRA or other PEFT techniques.
* Familiarity with robotic learning and action-generation approaches, including ACT, Diffusion Policy, imitation learning, or reinforcement learning.
* Experience with multi-camera perception, visual feature fusion, or related computer vision pipelines.
* Understanding of model profiling, pruning, quantization, or other model optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA DeepStream, TensorRT, or GPU-accelerated inference is an advantage.
* Knowledge of embeddings, vector search, and multimodal data processing is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to conduct experiments and translate research findings into practical engineering solutions.

**Why Join?**

* Work on emerging technologies at the intersection of multimodal AI, foundation models, and robotics.
* Develop AI systems that connect visual perception, intelligent planning, and physical execution.
* Explore advanced approaches to VLA model adaptation, action generation, and multimodal learning.
* Contribute to real-world AI applications involving autonomous systems and intelligent perception.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineers working on challenging AI research and development projects.

title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
Founding AI Engineer - Multimodal & Real-Time Systems
  

**Project Vision | Gurugram | Full-time | On-site**

**Experience Required : Candidate's capability**

**Expected Compensation : Decided in agreement with the candidate (We believe in a "You Prove, You Decide") mechanism.**

**Founding engineering hire. Hands-on technical ownership. Direct collaboration with the founders.**

Project Vision is an early-stage consumer AI venture operating in stealth.

We are building a product at the intersection of multimodal intelligence, natural voice interaction and responsive visual interfaces. Our ambition is to make interactions with AI more contextual, useful and intuitive.

We are hiring one Founding AI Engineer to take ownership of the initial technical build—from architecture and model integration to a working product that people can use.

You will begin as our sole engineer, working directly with the founders and founding team. You should be comfortable making technical decisions, writing substantial code yourself, identifying risks early and taking responsibility for the complete user experience.

What you will own

* Translate the product vision into a focused MVP, technical architecture and achievable development milestones.
* Build the first product across AI services, backend systems and a usable mobile-oriented interface.
* Integrate image/video understanding, voice input, spoken responses and contextual reasoning.
* Build reliable orchestration for model calls, tools, retrieval, session state and user-authorized memory.
* Develop structured visual responses using appropriate combinations of text, imagery, diagrams, comparisons and other interface components.
* Engineer streaming, synchronization and interruption handling so users can change direction without losing conversational continuity.
* Select models and infrastructure through practical experiments involving quality, latency, reliability and cost.
* Establish evaluation datasets, regression checks, logging and monitoring.
* Implement appropriate controls for camera/microphone access, personal data, stored preferences and external actions.
* Own deployment, documentation and the engineering foundations that future contributors can build upon.

The initial approach will combine existing AI capabilities with original product engineering. You will help determine where custom development creates meaningful value.

What we need to see

**Evidence of shipping**

You have built and deployed AI-enabled software beyond tutorials and isolated demonstrations. You can explain your personal contribution, the architecture, the failures encountered and what changed after real usage.

**Strong software engineering**

You can build reliable asynchronous services, APIs, data models and stateful applications. You understand debugging, testing, deployment and operational responsibility.

**Applied AI depth**

You have practical experience with model APIs, structured outputs, tool use, context management and evaluation. You understand the limitations of probabilistic systems and build appropriate controls around them.

**Multimodal and real-time capability**

You can demonstrate relevant work involving visual understanding, voice, streaming or interactive media—and explain how you would combine these into a responsive product.

**End-to-end product ownership**

You can work across backend and frontend boundaries and deliver a coherent experience. You care about what the user sees, hears and can successfully accomplish.

**Sound technical judgment**

You can make scope decisions, choose sensible dependencies, measure trade-offs and communicate when an assumption needs validation.

**Independent execution**

You are comfortable beginning without an established engineering team or a fully specified implementation plan. You can turn ambiguity into experiments, decisions and working software.

Particularly relevant experience

* Real-time voice, audio/video applications, WebRTC, WebSockets or similar streaming systems.
* Vision-language models and image/video processing pipelines.
* Dynamic interfaces, scene composition, graphics or multimedia synchronization.
* Mobile applications or responsive browser-based products.
* Personalization, retrieval and permission-based memory.
* Taking an early product from an initial prototype to sustained real-world use.
* Building effectively with AI coding tools while retaining ownership of correctness and maintainability.

We are open to different technology stacks. Explain why your choices fit the problem.

Experience and qualifications

We expect most suitable candidates to have approximately 4–10 years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on AI product work.

Demonstrated capability matters more than an exact experience bracket, college name or degree. Candidates outside this range with exceptional relevant work are welcome.

What the first six months should establish

The objective is a focused, usable product suitable for early-user testing and investor demonstrations, supported by evidence about technical feasibility, experience quality, reliability and operating cost.

You will help define the scope and milestones with the founders. The broader product roadmap will evolve from what we learn.

What this role offers

* Ownership of the initial architecture and implementation.
* Direct access to the founders and influence over product decisions.
* The opportunity to establish the engineering foundations of a new AI business.
* Substantial technical responsibility from the beginning.

**Compensation:**
Open for discussion based on demonstrated capability, relevant experience and the scope of ownership.

How to apply

Apply with your résumé and links to your strongest relevant work.

For one or two projects, briefly explain:

1. What the system does and where we can see it.
2. What you personally designed and implemented.
3. One difficult engineering problem you solved.
4. Any measured results involving users, quality, latency, reliability or cost.

GitHub, deployed applications, technical write-ups, open-source contributions and recorded demonstrations are all welcome.

If your strongest work is confidential, describe your contribution without sharing proprietary information. We can discuss an appropriate private walkthrough.

Selection process

1. Application and project review.
2. Initial conversation and technical project deep dive.
3. A time-boxed engineering assessment for shortlisted candidates.
4. An in-office technical and founder discussion in Gurugram.
5. Reference checks and offer discussion.

Further product details will be shared progressively during the process.

We are looking for someone who can make thoughtful technical decisions and turn them into a product that works.

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.
