title: AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability
description:
Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Manage change to data platforms.
* Perform incident triage for platform issues.
* Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
* Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
* Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
* Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
* Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
* Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
* Championing the features that the business need.
* Translating complex technology into consumable business language. Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
* Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Communication
* Problem solving
* SQL
* Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
* Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Associate, Grid, PI - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

Our GRID Product Provides Hyperlocal Geospatial Intelligence Solution That Supports Various Industries Like Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, Travel & Logistics In Making Data-backed, Intelligent Decisions. GRID Brings Together Both Functional Expertise And Scalable Tech Stack For
  
  

* Site-level intelligence on asset supply coverage and user experience (for both client and competitors)
* Advanced Analytics platform for scenario modelling and optimization algorithms
* Enhanced real-time visualization and collaboration, distributed across the client org (assets, strategy, marketing etc.)
* Working with cross-functional teams using a ‘single source of truth’ that aligns customer “demand” data and asset “supply” data

**How You Will Contribute**
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate with a proven track record in developing new products & managing product-led consulting delivery, leveraging Geospatial Analytics as part of our GRID team. This role involves overseeing the development, analysis, and application of geospatial data to drive strategic decision-making for our corporate and private equity clients. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in geospatial analytics with strong project management skills to deliver impactful solutions across various domains such as CAPEX Optimization, Go-to-market, Cost to serve, Market Attractiveness, White space opportunity, Competitive intensity etc. across multiple industries with focus on Telecom (Fiber, Tower and Data Centre), Retail, Healthcare, Travel and Hospitality etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Building a high performing global centre of excellence for geospatial analytics within Performance Improvement Practice
* Executing the collection, processing, and analysis of geospatial data using advanced GIS tools and methodologies
* Develop and maintain geospatial databases to ensure data integrity and accuracy
* Contribute to the creation of high-quality maps and visualizations that effectively communicate data insights
* Support senior analysts in conducting spatial analyses and modelling
* Assist in implementing spatial analysis techniques such as distance calculations and spatial overlays
* Assist in managing GIS projects across various disciplines, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance technical skills in geospatial technologies
* Position A&M Global Capability Center as a thought partner within the firm for building new solutions and offerings

**Qualifications**

* Comes with 1-5 years of relevant hands-on experience working with a global consulting firm, delivering geospatial driven analytics consulting services delivery for corporate and PE clients
* MBA or Master’s from a top-tier institute
* Have strong knowledge on various spatial models and algorithms to solve complex problems
* Proficiency in solutions around Geo Spatial Analytics (custom solutions, scenario modelling, large volume rendering, foot traffic, shape file formats)
* Proficiency in technical skills
* Python (Geospatial libraries like geopandas), SQL, Alteryx
* Visualization tools (ArcGIS, QGIS, PowerBI, CARTO)
* Statistical Analysis methodologies (Gradient Boost, Random Forest)
* Microsoft Office Suite (must have)
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Principal Manager, Tech (Jsh)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for exceptional developers to join our JSH team based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, and Gurugram. As a member of the team, you will get to work on the firm’s analytical portfolio, risk management, and optimization engine for most of the discretionary strategies. The team focuses on making all this functionality available in real time by reengineering the current architecture and design. The team also supports our quant, portfolio managers, and traders’ requirements by adding necessary support to the engine and building various tools.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
As a member of the team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing complex financial trading systems that process large volumes of data customized to different business groups, focusing on scalability, reusability, performance, efficiency, and fault tolerance. You will also review and implement complex design and code that meets the requirements of multiple stakeholders. In this role, you will need to understand the complexities of multi-threaded and multi-forked systems that cater to ever-changing business needs and balance the long-term “big picture” and short-term implications of design decisions. Additionally, you will need to understand the product and project management space and plan roadmaps and deliverables in a manner that maximizes business capabilities. You will further be responsible for coaching, guiding, and mentoring various engineers working across different efforts by providing oversight and direction.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or any related discipline with 7 to 13 years of core software development experience
* Exceptional computer science fundamentals in algorithms, data structures, databases, operating systems, etc.
* Expertise in designing and developing complex systems and the ability to translate a vague high-level requirement into a well-structured and coherent system design and to build LLD, mentor juniors, and conduct solid code reviews
* Proven problem-solving skills and robust knowledge of data structures and algorithms
* Excellent hands-on development skills in prototype technical solutions
* The ability to mentor and coach junior team members
* The ability to work with a diverse set of stakeholders, bring in the right prioritizations and deliver to the dynamically changing requirements
* Extensive hands-on experience in building multithreaded systems using C++ and Python
* Excellent technical communication skills

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience working in the finance domain
* Mentoring or people management experience

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LdTechjshMar2025
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers.
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB’s customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows.
  
  
The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB’s top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes.
  
  
This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services.
  
  
You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
* Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
* Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
* Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
* Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
* Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
* Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
* Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
* Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
* Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
* Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
* Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

**Responsibilities**
Technical Delivery
  
  

* Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms.

Marketing Technology Engineering
  
  

* Own and enhance capabilities across:

+ Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
+ Marketing enrichment and data normalization
+ Campaign and campaign member management
+ Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
+ Territory planning and account assignment
+ Activity and engagement management
+ Outreach and business development workflows
+ Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
+ Annual planning and operational planning processes

Integration and System Design
  
  

* Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms.

Data Quality and Governance
  
  

* Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data.

Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns.

Platform Optimization
  
  

* Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
* Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
* Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
* Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
* Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
* Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
* Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures
  
  
In 3 Months
  
  
Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment.
  
  
In 6 Months
  
  
Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations.
  
  
In 12 Months
  
  
Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Physical AI Software
description:
**Job Description**
*Business Unit: Mobile Robotics| Function: NPD |Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India*
**Role Overview**
Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz is looking for a Physical AI Software to own the software architecture and technical leadership for autonomous mobile robot (AMR) platforms within the Mobile Robotics business. This role sits at the intersection of classical autonomy stacks (perception, localization, navigation, control) and emerging Physical AI capabilities such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and Vision-Language Models (VLM), and is directly responsible for taking systems from prototype to reliable, field-deployed fleets. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on robotics software expertise with the leadership skills to mentor a team, drive architecture decisions, and resolve real-world deployment challenges in customer environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Systems Integration**

* Lead end-to-end software architecture for mobile robotics platforms — perception, localization/SLAM, navigation, motion control, and safety systems.
* Own design decisions around ROS/ROS 2 middleware, sensor fusion pipelines, and modular hardware abstraction layers.
* Act as technical lead for fleet-level coordination and communication interfaces (REST, MQTT, CAN).
* Set technical direction and coding/architecture standards for the team; review designs and code from other engineers.

**Physical AI, VLA/VLM & Perception**

* Drive integration of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and Vision-Language Model (VLM) capabilities into the autonomy stack for tasks such as semantic scene understanding, instruction-conditioned navigation, and object/task-level reasoning.
* Own the Visual SLAM pipeline (e.g., ORB-SLAM, VINS, RTAB-Map or equivalent) for robust localization and mapping across dynamic, GPS-denied, and visually repetitive warehouse/industrial environments.
* Evaluate, fine-tune, and productionize foundation-model-based perception and reasoning components, balancing on-robot compute constraints with model accuracy and latency.
* Integrate and validate AI/ML models in production for localization, obstacle detection, and object/pallet identification.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4-6 years of experience in mobile robotics / autonomous systems software, with demonstrated ownership of production AMR deployments.
* Strong hands-on experience with ROS / ROS 2, including middleware architecture and sensor fusion.
* Proven experience with Visual SLAM techniques and libraries, and a solid grasp of localization and mapping in real-world, GPS-denied environments.
* Working knowledge of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and/or Vision-Language Model (VLM) approaches, and how to integrate foundation-model-based perception into constrained, real-time robotic systems.
* Practical experience with controllers such as PID, Stanley, or Model Predictive Control (MPC) for motion/velocity control.
* Demonstrated track record of diagnosing and resolving field/deployment issues in live customer or warehouse environments (not simulation-only experience).
* Proficiency in Python and C++ for robotics software development; familiarity with OpenCV, NumPy/SciPy, and standard ROS toolchains.
* Experience with fleet-level communication protocols (REST, MQTT, CAN) and hardware-in-the-loop or simulation-based testing frameworks.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring a small technical team, or clear readiness to step into a team-lead capacity.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Engineering (Robotics, Instrumentation, Computer Science, Electronics, or related discipline) required

**About Novus Hi-tech Robotic Systemz**
Novus Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz Pvt. Ltd. builds autonomous systems across ADAS, ADAS Aftermarket, Mobile Robotics, and Defence Robotics. The Mobile Robotics business unit focuses on autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for warehouse, industrial, and logistics environments, combining perception, navigation, and AI to deliver reliable, field-ready autonomy at scale.

description:

title: Generative AI Engineer – Data Engineering
description:

It seamlessly integrates with LLM endpoints, voice bots, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows to provide continuous oversight and control. The platform runs proprietary hallucination detectors, adversarial red-team probes, and drift monitors to identify and mitigate AI risks in real time. * Experience with cloud platforms and data infrastructure tools (such as data warehouses, distributed storage, orchestration frameworks, or workflow schedulers).
* Knowledge of AI safety, governance, or compliance considerations, and interest in aligning data systems with industry standards and regulatory frameworks.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Gurugram, collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate clearly, and take ownership of end-to-end technical deliverables.
* Experience in high-growth or startup environments and prior work on production AI or analytics platforms is a plus.

title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.
  
  
**Role Description**
This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.
  
  
The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.
* Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.
* Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.
* Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.
* Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.
* Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment.
* Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review.
* Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems.
* You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools.
* You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity.
* You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending.
* You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank.
* You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment.
* You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team.
* You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders.
* Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable.

Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway.
  
  
**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
  
  
**Flexible working**
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
  
  
**Diversity**
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

An SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for leading enterprise AI initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance.
  
  
The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation.
  
  
As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities.
  
  
From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains.
  
  
The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale.
  
  
The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results.
  
  
Ultimately, an SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is expected to provide broad organizational leadership, own enterprise-scale AI platforms and programs, drive adoption and value realization, build high-performing teams, ensure governance and operational excellence, and serve as the accountable leader for delivering transformative AI capabilities that advance the organization's strategic objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Lead Gen AI & Agentic AI Engineer
description:
* **Experience:**
  5+ years
* **Primary Stack:**
  Python, LLM APIs, RAG, agent frameworks
* **Cloud:**
  Cloud-agnostic. Deep experience with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure, and the ability to work on the others
* **Location & Mode:**
  Full-time, Work From Office. Noida, Sector 132
* **Company:**
  Binariq (TSCx Consulting Pvt Ltd)

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a Lead Gen AI & Agentic AI Engineer to own the design and delivery of LLM-powered and autonomous agent systems for enterprise clients. You will take a business problem from an early client conversation through to a production system, making the architecture calls along the way and defending them to both technical and non-technical audiences.

We need someone who has built agents that run against live client systems. That means scoping what an agent can access, deciding where a human has to approve, and handling failures predictably when it acts.

Developing the engineers around you is a core part of this role. You will mentor associate engineers day to day, assist in running Binariq's internal training on Gen AI and agentic practice, and own the technical onboarding path for engineers joining the practice.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Design & Build**

* Own end-to-end design of Gen AI solutions: retrieval architecture, model selection, prompt strategy, and integration approach
* Design agentic systems: tool contracts, orchestration logic, state management, and multi-agent decomposition where it is justified
* Define the boundaries of autonomy: what an agent may access, what it may act on, where a human must approve, and how it escalates
* Build guardrails against prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, and unsafe or incorrect output
* Design failure behaviour explicitly: retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, cost ceilings, and rollback paths
* Establish evaluation frameworks for LLM and agent output, and use them to drive iteration rather than relying on impressions
* Treat token and inference cost as a first-class design constraint

**Client & Delivery**

* Work directly with client stakeholders to shape requirements and explain technical trade-offs
* Support pre-sales and solutioning by estimating effort, assessing feasibility, and identifying risk early
* Set technical direction on engagements and review the team's work against it
* Hand over production-ready systems with the necessary instrumentation and documentation

**Training & Capability Building**

* Mentor associate engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussion
* Assist in executing Binariq's internal training on Gen AI and agentic engineering
* Own the technical onboarding path for engineers joining the practice, so new joiners reach useful output quickly
* Set and enforce engineering standards across the team, covering evaluation, guardrails, and safe agent design
* Build reusable patterns, reference implementations, and internal documentation the team can work from

**Required Technical Skills**

**Programming & Architecture**

* Strong
  **Python**
  , including asynchronous programming, packaging, and testing discipline
* **FastAPI**
  or equivalent, with sound API and microservices design
* **SQL**
  and NoSQL, with judgement about which fits a given problem
* System design: how the AI components sit within a wider client architecture

**Generative AI (depth expected)**

* Production experience with multiple
  **LLM providers**
  , and informed opinions about their trade-offs
* **Advanced RAG**
  : chunking strategy, embedding model selection, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, query rewriting, and diagnosing retrieval failure
* **Vector databases**
  : practical experience, including indexing strategy and retrieval performance at scale
* **Prompt and context engineering**
  at system level, not just per call
* **Evaluation methodology**
  : designing test sets, measuring groundedness and accuracy, and building regression suites for non-deterministic output
* **Guardrails and safety**
  : prompt injection defence, output filtering, PII handling in prompts
* **LangChain / LlamaIndex**
  , with a clear view of when not to use a framework

**Agentic AI (the core of this role)**

* **Tool and function calling**
  : designing tool contracts, schemas, and error semantics
* Production experience with at least one agent framework:
  **LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic**

**Kernel, Google ADK**
, or equivalent

* **Orchestration and state management**
  across long-running, multi-step workflows
* **Agent memory**
  : short-term context and persistent state
* **Human-in-the-loop design**
  : approval gates, escalation, and deciding where autonomy should stop
* **Permissioning and sandboxing**
  : scoping agent access to systems and data
* F
  **ailure recovery and loop control**
  : preventing runaway execution and runaway cost
* **Tracing and observability**
  for agent runs (Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar)
* M
  **CP (Model Context Protocol)**
* Multi-agent architecture, and the judgement to know when a single agent is the better answer

**Cloud**

* Deep hands-on experience with at least one of:
* **AWS**
  : Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda
* **GCP**
  : Vertex AI, Cloud Run
* **Azure**
  : Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure ML
* Ability to become productive on the others, since client stacks vary
* IAM, secrets management, and cloud security fundamentals
* Docker, and enough CI/CD literacy to hand over cleanly

**Good to Have**

* Fine-tuning open-source models (LoRA, PEFT, QLoRA) and a view on when fine-tuning beats retrieval
* Lightweight AI/ML Ops exposure: enough monitoring to know when something has broken in production
* Self-hosted and open-weight deployment (vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face), relevant for data residency and air-gapped clients
* Multi-modal systems: document, image, or voice
* Classic predictive ML, for engagements that combine it with Gen AI
* Regulated-domain delivery experience (BFSI, healthcare, public sector, defence)
* Consulting or client-facing delivery background
* Conference talks, published writing, or open-source contribution

**Experience Requirements**

* **5+ years**
  of overall software engineering experience
* **3+ years**
  hands-on with Gen AI or LLM-based application development
* **Hands-on agentic build experience**
  : a system that called tools and took real actions across services, rather than one that only generated text. Production deployment with real users is strongly preferred; a substantial internal or proof-of-concept build will be considered where the candidate can explain the permissioning model, the failure handling, and what they would change to take it to production
* Demonstrable ownership of architecture decisions, including ones that turned out to be wrong and what you changed
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders
* Demonstrable experience developing other engineers, through mentoring, technical leadership, or running training. Experience building a curriculum or onboarding programme is a strong advantage

**What We're Looking For**

* **Architecture judgement.**
  Knowing when a simple RAG pipeline beats an agent, and being willing to say so to a client who asked for an agent.
* **Commitment to developing others.**
  Raising the level around you is part of the role, not an extra. We are building a practice, and the team's depth matters as much as any single engagement.
* **Caution with autonomy.**
  Understanding the risk of letting an agent act on a client's live systems, and designing for it.
* **Evaluation discipline.**
  Measuring output quality with test sets and defined metrics.
* **Portable fundamentals.**
  Our work spans different clients, clouds, and constraints. We look for people who understand how things work underneath, so their skills transfer.
* **Clear communication.**
  You will explain technical limitations and trade-offs to client stakeholders who do not share your background.

**Notes on Scope**

**This is a build role, not a platform role.**
Owning client production infrastructure, platform monitoring, and cost governance at scale is not what we are hiring for. That said, you should be comfortable deploying and running your own work, and you are expected to instrument and document your systems properly.

title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**Role:**
Lead AI Engineer

**Function:**
Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning Engineering

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu & Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.

A team of 740 operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation. Engineers here build AI products that touch millions of listeners, creators, and advertisers daily.

**Position Overview**

The company is building AI products for listeners, creators, and advertisers — and this role sits at the centre of that effort. As a senior individual contributor, you will take fuzzy business conversations and turn them into shipped, measurable AI systems: designing the architecture, building the pipelines, and owning the outcomes. This is not a research role — the bar is production, not demos.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Translate business-level asks ('smarter recommendations', 'automate the ad-copy thing') into concrete technical designs — components, data flows, model choices, cost estimates, and a build plan; write specs when needed and push back when AI is the wrong tool.
* Design full AI systems end-to-end: service boundaries, APIs, queues, caching, vector and SQL storage, latency budgets, failure modes, and observability dashboards — with cost-per-request and SLOs as first-class concerns.
* Build and ship LLM-powered products using structured prompting, few-shot patterns, prompt versioning, evals, and guardrails; implement multi-step agentic workflows using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks with state management, tool calling, and retries.
* Architect and maintain RAG pipelines — chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search and reranking, retrieval quality evaluation, and index freshness.
* Measure everything: offline evals, online A/B tests, and real numbers on quality, latency, and cost; 'it feels better' is a gut-check, not a launch criterion.
* Make model routing and hosting decisions across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models; evaluate self-hosting trade-offs and fine-tuning ROI honestly.
* Mentor engineers, run design reviews, and own your slice of the AI product roadmap — keeping the team current on a fast-moving ecosystem without chasing every shiny repo.

**Must Have Criteria**

* 6+ years of software engineering experience with strong backend and system design depth — services that have met real traffic and real 3 a.m. failures.
* Demonstrated track record of building and shipping LLM-powered products in production — shipped, monitored, and costed; notebook demos do not count.
* Hands-on production experience with prompting (structured, few-shot, versioning, evals, guardrails), RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph.
* Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML system development.
* Experience with AWS (primary) or another major cloud provider, including CI/CD pipelines and production-grade infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to take a business-level ask and independently produce the technical concept and design — more than once.
* Strong written communication: specs, design docs, and code that other engineers can read and build on.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in media, radio, streaming, or advertising technology.
* Experience with fine-tuning, eval tooling (Ragas, LangSmith, Braintrust, or equivalent), or ranking and recommender systems.
* Voice or audio AI experience — STT/TTS pipelines, audio understanding.
* Prior formal leadership experience — hiring, mentoring, growing a team; strong ICs looking to move in this direction are equally welcome.
* Startup experience with broad ownership across architecture, implementation, and operations.

**What We Offer**

* End-to-end IC ownership of AI products serving millions of listeners, creators, and advertisers on a greenfield media super-app.
* Direct influence on product direction — you shape what gets built, not just how.
* Collaborative environment with product and engineering teams working on high-impact personalisation, content intelligence, and advertising AI problems.
* Exposure to a fast-moving AI stack with the autonomy to make real architectural and tooling decisions.

title: Lead Operations Researcher
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Praxas AI is the AI-native decision layer for supply chains. We sit on top of the ERP a company already runs and continuously re-optimize what to make, stock, buy and ship as conditions change helping four primary departments: sourcing, inventory, production planning and logistics. When a supplier slips or a rush order lands, Praxas recommends the response (accelerate a PO, delay a production run, adjust safety stock), and our agents carry it out with Human-on-the-loop approval, , with the long term goal shifting to Human-in-the-loop approval.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring our first Operations Research Engineer to own the math behind every Praxas decision. You'll build the optimization engine for production planning first, then inventory, sourcing and logistics.

This is a hands-on build role, not academic research or consulting. You'll turn messy factory realities (capacities, changeovers, bills of materials, late suppliers) into models that run on real customer data and re-plan continuously. You'll move between a planner's desk on a factory floor, a solver log and a whiteboard with our engineers without losing the thread.

Our principle is simple: the solver decides, the AI explains and acts. You own the solver. You'll work directly with the founders, our AI and data engineers, and the planners who use what you build every day.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the decision engine**

• Model real plants: capacities, routings, bills of materials, changeovers, labor, material availability and due dates.

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling problems (lot sizing, sequencing, capacity allocation) that minimize lost sales and cost.

• Pick the right method for each problem: mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics or decomposition.

• Keep solve times fast enough to re-plan on demand for plants with hundreds of products.

• Design models that are configured per customer (industry, production type, demand pattern), not rewritten per customer.

**Make re-optimization continuous and trustworthy**

• Build rolling-horizon re-planning that reacts to new orders, delays and breakdowns without reshuffling the whole plan.

• Use time fences, frozen windows and change penalties so planners can trust the schedule.

• Turn the trade-off between optimality and stability into a setting planners understand.

• Model uncertainty in demand, lead times and yields with stochastic or robust approaches.

**Extend into inventory optimization and forecasting**

• Build inventory optimization: safety stock, reorder points, service-level targets and multi-location policies.

• Use probabilistic forecasts (ranges, not single numbers) as optimizer inputs, working with our forecasting engine.

• Backtest every model against customer history before it touches a live plan.

Ship with customers and the team

• Work directly with planners and plant heads at our design partners to validate constraints and results.

• Feed our AI agents the decisions they act on: delay a production run, expedite a PO, adjust safety stock.

• Tell our data engineers exactly what data each model needs, and how to handle missing or messy inputs.

• Define and track the metrics that prove value: lost sales avoided, inventory freed, on-time-in-full and machine utilization.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days**

• Ship v1 of the production planning model, running on real data from our first design partners.

• Set a baseline for each partner: current lost sales, utilization, changeover time and plan versus actual.

• Agree solve-time and plan-stability targets with the team, and meet them on partner data.

• Document every model's formulation, assumptions and parameters so others can extend it.

**Within 6–12 months**

• Run continuous re-optimization in production for every customer, with stability controls planners trust.

• Deliver results customers sign off on: fewer lost sales, less excess inventory and better on-time-in-full.

• Connect inventory optimization and probabilistic forecasts to production planning in one engine.

• Build reusable model templates by production type (job shop, batch, assembly, continuous) to cut implementation time.

• Own the operations research roadmap, and help hire and mentor as the team grows.

**Who You Are**

**Required**

• Operations research and advanced modeling: design and implement advanced analytical models using techniques such as mixed-integer linear programming, discrete event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic modeling and decision analysis under uncertainty.

• Experience building optimization or planning models that real operations ran on, beyond academic work.

• Strong formulation skills in mixed-integer and/or constraint programming.

• Experience with optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, etc.).

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Working knowledge of production planning: master scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, lot sizing and sequencing.

• Solid probability and statistics, including demand uncertainty and safety stock math.

• Production-quality Python and comfortable SQL.

• Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

**Preferred**

• Experience at a supply chain planning software company (such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or Coupa), or on an in-house planning or OR team at a manufacturer, retailer or 3PL.

• Rolling-horizon planning and schedule-stability methods used in production systems.

• Inventory optimization: service-level targets, (s, S) and (R, S) policies, multi-echelon networks.

• Forecasting for intermittent or lumpy demand (Croston, SBA, TSB) and probabilistic forecasts.

• Heuristics, metaheuristics or decomposition for large problem instances.

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Process industries (chemicals, food, CPG): batches, shelf life, sequence-dependent cleaning.

• Experience with Indian mid-market manufacturers or their ERPs (Tally, SAP Business One).

• APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

• Experience pairing optimization with LLM or agent systems.

• Familiarity with Silver, Pyke and Thomas, Inventory and Production Management in Supply Chains, the foundation of our engine.

**What We Offer**

• A founding-team role where you own the core IP the company is built on.

• Competitive salary plus meaningful ESOPs.

• Real customer data from day one, and a direct line to the founders.

• The chance to define how a new generation of supply chain software makes decisions.

We are second-time entrepreneurs and operators behind Momspresso, acquired by Honasa/Mamaearth in 2023, along with leadership experience across companies like Unilever, PepsiCo, Aviva, and WinZO.
  
  
We have worked with 300+ brands across FMCG, BFSI, DTC, healthcare, retail, and other consumer categories.
  
  
**The Role**
We're hiring an AI Platform Engineer to build and own the shared runtime our AI agents run on, and the evals that keep it honest.
  
  
We run AI agents on behalf of brands. Those agents need one gateway to the models, one place prompts get routed, and one gate that checks what is allowed before anything ships. And they need proof they work, because a brand cannot take our word for it.
  
  
Reports to the engineering lead. Individual contributor. Office in Gurugram, Monday to Friday.
  
  
**The Hard Problems**

* Build one agent runtime that new use cases plug into, without forking the code.
* Build evals strong enough to block a bad release, not just report on it.
* Run a policy gate on every generated asset, fast enough to sit in the request path.
* Keep many brands on one platform, where Brand A''s memory never reaches Brand B''s output.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Agent runtime and LLM gateway: Own one reusable platform for agent orchestration, tool execution and prompt routing, with a single path to Anthropic, OpenAI and others (caching, dedup, fallback, retries).
* Evals and release gates: Build the offline and online eval harness, golden datasets, calibrated LLM-as-judge and a CI regression gate that stops a prompt change that drops a score.
* Cost, retrieval and latency: Own inference spend per unit of output, prompt caching, and vector search over brand history (pgvector or similar) wired into the agents.
* Safety and brand isolation: Own the sandboxed policy gate, disclosure metadata and audit log on every asset, prompt-injection defence, four autonomy tiers, a kill switch and one-step rollback.
* Observability and design: Trace every agent step with OpenTelemetry so a wrong output points to the step that caused it, and own high-level and low-level design.

**What We''re Looking For**

* 3–5 years of total experience, with 2+ years in backend engineering. Python, FastAPI in production.
* Shipped an LLM or agent system to production: not a demo, not a notebook.
* Built a platform others build on: SDK, shared service or internal framework with real users.
* Built an eval harness that blocked a bad release. Tell us about the release it blocked.
* Cost or latency work you can quantify. You cut a number and you know how.
* RAG in production. Embeddings, a vector store, chunking choices you can defend.
* Cloud and CI/CD. AWS or GCP, Docker, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Distributed systems basics. Caching, queues, idempotency, P99 latency.
* Written design docs. Led at least a small team or a large project end to end.
* Good to have: eval tooling (Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, or your own), policy engines (OPA/Rego, sandboxes), content provenance (C2PA, watermarking, EU AI Act), ad tech or martech, and side projects with agents. We read them.

**Why Join**
We''re not just building software. We''re reshaping how brands understand and scale creativity with AI. You will build the platform every agent runs on, and the measurement that proves it works.

title: Quantitative Researcher - Early Career (INDIA)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets.

Our Quantitative Researchers are embedded within the following teams{{:}}

**Alpha Researcher{{:}}**

As a member of the Alpha Researcher team, you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models.

**Data Scientist{{:}}**

As a member of the Data Science team, you will be involved in parsing and analyzing large data sets, working on discovering and obtaining new sources of data and collaborating with the Alpha and Strategy team to build predictive machine learning models.

**Strategy Researcher{{:}}**

As a member of the Strategy team, you will be developing systematic strategies based on a variety of machine learning and statistical methods. The data you train and validate comes from actual market trading

When you apply for a Quantitative Researcher role at Trexquant, we will first assess you on the core skills required for the Quantitative Researcher. During the interview process, we will be able to get to know you better, learn about your strengths and match you to the best research team that closely aligns with your skills and preference.

**Your Responsibilities{{:}}**

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse data sets to be used for future alpha(strategy) development
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Collaborate with experienced and resourceful quantitative researchers to carry out experiments and test hypothesis using simulations

**Requirements**

* Graduate degree (Bachelors, Masters, or PhD) in any STEM discipline from a prestigious institution
* Passion for machine learning and quantitative finance
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player
* Proficient in programming languages such as Python
* Previous experience in alpha research and the development of trading signals and strategies
* The role is also open for candidates graduating from Tier 1 campuses in 2027

**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation with bonus tied to the performance of algorithms you develop
* Work in a collaborative and friendly environment, participate in decision-making process for research direction, and have opportunity to lead on new ideas
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

title: Principal Engineer
description:
****About Payoneer****
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Principal Engineer – Backend
  
  
****About Payoneer****
Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.
  
  
As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.
  
  
The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.
* Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.
* Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.
* Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.
* Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.
* Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.
* Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.
* Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.
* Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.
* Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.
* Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.
* Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.
* Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

****What We're Looking For****

* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.
* Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.
* Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.
* Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.
* Experience operating systems at significant scale with strong requirements around availability, performance, security, and reliability.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, observability, production operations, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience with AI/LLM technologies and a demonstrated interest in building AI-first engineering systems and workflows.
* Familiarity with AI agents, MCP (Model Context Protocol), tool calling, agentic workflows, or similar emerging AI technologies is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence engineering and product decisions across organizational boundaries.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and technical leaders.
* Strong product mindset and the ability to balance technical excellence with business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a globally distributed, cross-functional engineering environment.

****What Success Looks Like****
In this role, success means having an impact beyond the systems you directly build.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Shape the architecture and technical direction of critical Payoneer platforms.
* Enable multiple engineering teams to build and operate better distributed systems.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, architecture leadership, and engineering practices.
* Help Payoneer adopt an AI-first engineering culture and identify high-value opportunities for AI and agentic technologies.
* Drive successful adoption of emerging technologies such as MCP where appropriate.
* Improve the scalability, reliability, security, and efficiency of our platforms.
* Become a trusted technical partner to engineering, product, and business leadership.

**Why This Role**
The Principal Engineer role provides an opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, architecture, product, and organizational leadership.
  
  
You will work on complex problems at global scale, influence technology strategy across teams, mentor the next generation of engineering leaders, and help shape how Payoneer builds software in an increasingly AI-first world.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
****Build Each Other Up****
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*
