title: Lead AI Research Scientist (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Lead Physical AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Research Scientist**
to lead the development and adaptation of foundation models that connect visual perception, language understanding, and robotic actions.
  
  
You will guide research and implementation efforts to help robots interpret visual information, understand natural-language instructions, and generate meaningful actions for navigation and manipulation. The role combines multimodal AI, foundation model adaptation, robotic learning, and applied computer vision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the adaptation and development of Vision-Language-Action models for robotic applications.
* Fine-tune open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, and π0 for navigation and manipulation tasks.
* Develop multimodal representations that connect camera observations, natural-language instructions, spatial reasoning, and robot actions.
* Design action-tokenization and spatial waypoint generation approaches for robotic behavior.
* Develop parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipelines using techniques such as LoRA and other PEFT methods.
* Work with vision-language models, Vision Transformers (ViT), and large multimodal models.
* Integrate visual perception and AI capabilities into robotic decision-making systems.
* Explore cross-embodiment learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment to improve model generalization across robotic platforms.
* Collaborate with robotics controls and embedded systems teams to translate model outputs into executable robot behaviors.
* Lead research planning, technical evaluations, experiments, and model performance improvements.
* Guide researchers and engineers in model adaptation, training, evaluation, and deployment.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant experience in multimodal AI, foundation models, vision-language models, imitation learning, or robotic learning.
* Strong experience developing, training, or fine-tuning large multimodal models, Vision Transformers, or related deep learning architectures.
* Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch or JAX.
* Hands-on experience with vision-language models or Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures.
* Familiarity with open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, or π0.
* Experience with Hugging Face tools and model training or fine-tuning workflows.
* Practical knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA or related methods.
* Understanding of multimodal representation learning, visual perception, and language-conditioned action generation.
* Familiarity with robotic imitation learning, policy learning, or reinforcement learning.
* Understanding of cross-embodiment robotic learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment is an advantage.
* Ability to lead technical research, evaluate experimental results, and translate research findings into practical AI capabilities.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of emerging Physical AI and VLA technologies.
* Work at the intersection of multimodal AI, foundation models, and robotics.
* Explore new approaches to language-conditioned robotic navigation and manipulation.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to translate research into real-world applications.
* Shape technical direction and research priorities for advanced AI systems.

**Work Location & Arrangement**
Remote through a US-based research team, or hybrid in New Delhi, India. Remote eligibility is subject to the employer's approved work locations.

title: Manager- Data Governance and Responsible AI
description:
**Position: Manager – Data Governance and Responsible AI**
**Location: India- Chennai, New Delhi or Bengaluru. Hybrid, with travel to Athena offices, project sites and field partners in India and occasionally abroad**
**Position Type: Full Time**
**Experience: 8–12 years**
**About Athena**
Athena Infonomics is a research, advisory and implementation firm working with governments, multilateral institutions, foundations and companies on development and public-policy problems. We operate across India, the United States, EU, Asia and Africa. The group also includes TolaData, an impact-measurement software platform, and early-stage work in AI and digital public infrastructure.
  
  
Our work runs on data that is often personal, sensitive or confidential: household and beneficiary surveys, qualitative interviews with vulnerable groups, health and social-protection records, government administrative datasets, and proprietary client data. Much of it is collected in the field by our staff, enumerators and partners, then stored, analysed, shared and archived across several countries and tools. Our teams also use AI every day, on that same data.
  
  
Two things make this role necessary now. India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act and its Rules take effect in stages through 2026 and 2027, alongside GDPR and other regimes we already work under. And our use of AI has grown faster than the guardrails around it. We want one organisation-wide way of governing, protecting and using data that is practical for field teams and credible to clients, regulators and investors. This role builds and owns it.
  
  
**The role**
You will own how the Athena group governs, protects and uses data, including how it uses AI on client and participant data. You will design the framework, write the policies and tools, put them into daily use across practices and offices, and keep them current as law, clients and technology change. You will be the person clients, auditors and regulators talk to about our data practices, and the person our project teams call when a hard case comes up in the field.
  
  
This is a build-and-own role, not a compliance desk. You start with an independent diagnostic of where we stand; your job is to turn its findings into a working system and then run it. The measure of success is that a project manager in Chennai, a field coordinator in Nairobi and a product engineer at TolaData each know what they may do with data, do it without asking, and can show it if asked.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Build and own the data governance framework
* Take the findings of the independent diagnostic and turn them into a right-sized policy suite: data governance, data protection and privacy, information security, classification and handling, retention and disposal, third-party and field-partner data, breach and incident response, data sharing and publication.
* Set the governance model: who owns which data, who decides, and how the policies are kept current. Run the Data Governance Steering Group's cadence.
* Build the operating toolkit teams actually use: project data management plans (with a light version for low-risk work), consent frameworks for written, verbal, digital and low-literacy settings, DPIA and screening checklists, data sharing and processing agreement templates, field data protocols, project start-up and close-out checklists.
* Maintain the data inventory and record of processing activities across entities.
* Make the group compliant and keep it there
* Own readiness for India's DPDP Act and Rules across their phased deadlines, and for GDPR, UK GDPR, Kenya's Data Protection Act and client-specific requirements in the countries where we work.
* Act as, or stand up, the Data Protection Officer function; be the named contact for clients, data principals and regulators.
* Review data clauses in client contracts, sub-contracts and vendor agreements, working with external counsel where needed.
* Run breach and incident response when it is needed, and the drills before it is.
* Prepare TolaData for the certifications its customers and investors will expect (ISO 27001 and SOC 2 readiness), working with the product and engineering team and specialist consultants.
* Govern how we use AI
* Build and maintain the AI tool register and approval process: which tools, which data classes, under what vendor terms, with what human oversight.
* Write and keep current the Responsible AI policy, covering staff use of generative AI on client and participant data and the AI features in products we build for clients and in TolaData.
* Design AI risk assessment into the project lifecycle so teams can use AI productively with clear guardrails rather than being blocked by default.
* Stay close to how our teams and products actually use AI, and keep the rules practical as the tools change.
* Put it into daily practice
* Train leaders, project managers, data analysts, field coordinators and partner enumerators, using our own cases; build the short modules new staff and partners go through before they handle data.
* Work alongside project teams on live engagements: review data management plans, sit in on field design, resolve hard cases quickly.
* Run a light audit cycle: sample projects each year, trace data from collection to disposal, publish what was found and what changed.
* Track a small set of indicators the Co-Founders review each quarter, and report to clients and auditors when asked.

**How The Role Works**

* Scope. You are employed by Athena Infonomics, but the mandate spans the group. Expect a substantial share of your time on TolaData, which processes client monitoring data as a software platform and is preparing for institutional investment, and some on the group's AI ventures and its US federal work.
* Reporting. You report to the Co-Founder and a small Data Governance Steering Group that meets monthly. Practice heads, IT, the TolaData product lead and legal counsel sit on it. You set its agenda.
* Independence. You are expected to say no, in writing, when a project, product or client request cannot be done safely, and to propose what can. The Co-Founders will back that.
* Proportionate by design. Controls must match the sensitivity of the data and the risk. Low-risk work stays light. A framework field teams cannot follow in a low-connectivity, multi-language setting is a failed framework.
* Specialists on call. You will have a budget for external counsel, penetration testing and certification consultants. You decide when to use them; you do not need to be a lawyer or a security engineer yourself.
* Time zones and travel. The group works across India, East Africa, Europe and the United States. Some early-morning or evening calls are part of the job, as is travel to Athena offices, project sites and field partners.
* Discretion. You will see client data, contracts, incident reports and investor material from day one. Judgement about what to share, with whom, and when is a core requirement.
* Tools. We use AI tools every day for research, drafting and analysis. You should already work this way, and be able to govern it from the inside.

**Who We Are Looking For**
**Must have**

* 8–12 years of experience, with a substantial part spent building or running a data protection, privacy or data governance programme inside an organisation or for clients. You have implemented, not only advised.
* Working command of India's DPDP Act and Rules and of GDPR, and the ability to read a new regime or a client's data requirements and turn them into practice.
* Experience writing policies, procedures and templates that people actually used, and training people to use them.
* Enough information security literacy to run an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 readiness effort and to manage a security consultant well. You do not need to be the engineer.
* Practical understanding of how generative AI tools handle data (training, retention, hosting, account types) and of what responsible use looks like in an organisation.
* Excellent written English. Policies, guidance and client responses that a non-specialist can follow and a specialist cannot fault.
* Judgement and steadiness: comfortable taking a firm position with senior colleagues and clients, and finding the workable answer rather than the safest-sounding one.
* Fluent daily use of AI tools in your own work.

**Strongly Preferred**

* A recognised privacy or AI governance credential: CIPP/E, CIPM, DSCI DCPP or DCPLA, AIGP.
* Experience with research or development-sector data: informed consent, field data collection, enumerator partners, ethics review, vulnerable participants.
* Exposure to a software or SaaS business, including vendor security questionnaires, data processing agreements and certification audits.
* Experience working across several countries and legal regimes, including Kenya or other East African markets.
* Experience with donor and client data requirements from multilateral institutions, foundations and government clients.

**What Success Looks Like**
**Horizon**
**What is visibly true**
First 90 daysYou have absorbed the independent diagnostic, met every practice and office, and the Steering Group has agreed a prioritised plan with owners and dates. The data classification standard and the AI tool register are in use. The DPDP obligations that take effect in November 2026 are covered.By 12 monthsThe policy suite and toolkit are approved, published and in use on every new project. Leaders, project managers and field coordinators have been trained on Athena's own cases. Clients receive a standard answer to data and AI questions within days, not weeks. title: Principal Robotics Engineer (Motion Control)
description:

**Position Overview**
We are seeking a
**Principal Robotics Controls Engineer (Locomotion & MPC/RL)**
to lead the development of locomotion, dynamic balance, and real-time motion control systems for advanced legged robots.
  
  
You will design and implement control algorithms that enable robots to navigate uneven terrain, transition between gaits, recover from external disturbances, and execute movements reliably. The role combines robotics dynamics, model predictive control, reinforcement learning, simulation, and real-world hardware validation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development of the locomotion and motion control stack for legged robots.
* Translate high-level navigation goals into stable, executable robot movements.
* Design and implement nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Whole-Body Control (WBC), and related optimization-based control methods.
* Develop locomotion policies using deep reinforcement learning where appropriate.
* Implement robot kinematics, dynamics, state estimation, contact detection, and slip-recovery algorithms.
* Develop and validate gait transitions, obstacle negotiation, stair climbing, and recovery from external disturbances.
* Build simulation-based training and testing pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or comparable robotics simulation environments.
* Develop Sim-to-Real workflows to transfer locomotion policies from simulation to physical robots.
* Integrate motion control systems with motor controllers and communication networks, including CAN-FD and EtherCAT.
* Optimize control performance for low-latency, deterministic execution on real-time Linux systems.
* Collaborate with mechanical, embedded, perception, and AI teams to validate complete robotic systems.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of practical experience in robotics, motion control, legged locomotion, or closely related control engineering.
* Strong understanding of robot kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, and multi-body systems.
* Hands-on experience developing locomotion or motion control algorithms for legged robots.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and C++20.
* Practical experience with Model Predictive Control (MPC), nonlinear optimization, and Quadratic Programming (QP).
* Experience with Whole-Body Control (WBC) or related model-based control approaches.
* Familiarity with robotics libraries and frameworks such as Pinocchio, Drake, or OCS2.
* Experience with reinforcement learning for robotics or locomotion policy development.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or equivalent simulation platforms.
* Understanding of real-time control and PREEMPT\_RT Linux environments.
* Experience integrating control software with physical robot hardware and motor communication systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to lead complex robotics engineering projects.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of advanced robotic locomotion and control systems.
* Work on challenging problems involving dynamic balance, terrain traversal, and autonomous movement.
* Combine control theory, simulation, reinforcement learning, and physical robot testing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to move robotics research into practical applications.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an
**Research Scientist**
to push the boundaries of what AI systems can actually do.
  
  
Not someone who simply integrates existing models or builds another wrapper around an LLM. We're looking for someone who can identify why today's AI systems fail, develop new methods to overcome those limitations, and turn research breakthroughs into real-world capabilities.
  
  
You'll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building autonomous agents that can plan, reason, execute complex tasks and recover from failures; improving model intelligence through reinforcement learning and post-training; and developing systems that can make reliable decisions in unpredictable environments.
  
  
We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to use the best available model, but how to make AI fundamentally better at solving problems it struggles with today.
  
  
**The Job**

* Push the boundaries of agentic AI. Research and develop new approaches that enable AI agents to independently plan, reason, use tools, execute complex tasks, adapt to unfamiliar environments and recover from failures.
* Advance reinforcement learning and model training. Experiment with RL, fine-tuning, post-training techniques and model architectures to improve reasoning, decision-making and autonomous behaviour beyond what existing models can achieve.
* Develop new methods for reasoning and multimodal intelligence. Investigate why models struggle with complex, multi-step problems and unstructured inputs, and design new algorithms and techniques to improve their capabilities.
* Design rigorous experiments and AI evaluations. Build benchmarks, evaluation frameworks and experimental methodologies to measure model intelligence, reliability, generalisation and failure modes. Use findings to drive meaningful improvements.
* Take original research from first principles to production. Identify unsolved problems, formulate hypotheses, build and test new approaches, and collaborate with Research Engineers to translate breakthroughs into scalable AI systems with measurable real-world impact.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience conducting original AI research.
* Have a strong track record of original research, demonstrated through publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or EMNLP, impactful open-source contributions, or meaningful advances in production AI systems.
* Have deep expertise in one or more areas such as agentic AI, reinforcement learning, LLM reasoning, post-training, multimodal learning, model architectures or AI evaluations.
* Are highly proficient in Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience designing experiments, training and fine-tuning models, building evaluation frameworks and independently implementing research ideas.
* Are intellectually curious, comfortable challenging existing approaches and excited by unsolved problems. You combine scientific rigour with strong engineering instincts and care about taking original research from experimentation to real-world impact.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**

Univest is seeking a
**Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering**
to architect, build, and scale our next-generation automated trading and wealth management infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of systematic strategies in Indian derivatives (NSE Equities, Index & Stock Options/Futures)—from mathematical model design and backtesting to building low-latency, production-grade Python/C++ execution engines and broker API integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Research & Quantitative Modeling:**

* Design, validate, and deploy high-alpha systematic strategies (options arbitrage, dynamic delta-hedging, mean-reversion, trend-following, and statistical arbitrage) for Indian F&O markets.
* Model volatility surfaces, Option Greeks, order-book dynamics, and market microstructure to build robust edge cases.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, walk-forward validation, and stress-testing (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Monte Carlo simulations) to eliminate curve-fitting.

**Algorithmic Execution & Infrastructure Engineering:**

* Architect and program scalable, cloud-native server-side execution systems in
  **Python and C++**
  interfacing with broker APIs, OMS/EMS, and FIX protocols.
* Optimize execution algorithms to minimize market impact, slippage, and latencies across multi-broker retail setups.
* Build automated pre-trade and post-trade risk management engines handling real-time position limits, dynamic margin utilization, and drawdown controls.

**Leadership & Scale:**

* Own the strategy deployment roadmap across retail and high-net-worth portfolio tiers.
* Oversee data pipelines (tick-level/L2/L3 order book data), infrastructure, and strategy monitoring systems.

**Requirements**

* **Quantitative Depth:**
  Proven mastery of option pricing models (Black-Scholes, IV surfaces), stochastic calculus, statistical arbitrage, and risk metrics (VaR, Sharpe/Sortino, max drawdown controls).
* **Hands-on Production Code:**
  100% mandatory expertise in Python and/or modern C++ (C++17/20) for building backend trading engines, data pipelines, and API integrations.
* **Indian Derivatives Experience:**
  Deep, hands-on experience trading or engineering strategies specifically for NSE Index & Stock Options / Futures (Nifty, BankNifty, Stock Derivatives).
* Execution & Microstructure: Practical experience with broker APIs, OMS/EMS architectures, FIX protocol, or low-latency execution routing.

**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

* Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:

The BlackRock Data Office (BDO) advances the firm's enterprise data strategy by building trusted, scalable, and governed data products that power investment, business, operational, and technology outcomes across BlackRock. As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. **Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.

title: AI Benchmark & Red-Teaming Specialist
description:
**About Turing:**
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an analytical researcher and red-teaming specialist to build evidence-based web-research benchmark tasks that reliably expose weaknesses in state-of-the-art (SOTA) AI models (e.g., Claude Opus 5 Max). In this role, you will discover hard-to-surface facts, build precise research tasks around them, test them directly against leading LLMs, and diagnose the exact failure mechanisms in the model's search and reasoning paths.

Your work will directly shape AI evaluation frameworks, ensuring next-generation frontier models are tested against rigorous, non-trivial real-world research scenarios.

**Job Requirements:**

* **Core Experience:**
  1+ years in investigative research, fact-checking, AI benchmark task authoring, red-teaming, or technical QA review.
* **Benchmark Familiarity:**
  Proven experience authoring, testing, or reviewing tasks for AI benchmarks such as
  **GAIA, BrowseComp, SimpleQA, SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench, or Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE)**
  .
* **Analytical & OSINT Skills:**
  Intermediate-to-advanced web search and Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) skills; ability to navigate academic archives, local records, or obscure databases.
* **Model Trajectory Debugging:**
  Strong analytical capability to inspect model reasoning chains, search logs, and source selection to diagnose root causes of failure.
* **Precision Writing:**
  Ability to author clear, unambiguous benchmark prompts with bulletproof, primary-sourced answer keys.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Obscure Fact Discovery:**
  Deeply research niche topics to identify factual ground truths that cannot be surfaced via simple, direct search queries.
* **Source Verification:**
  Rigorously verify facts against primary or highly credible sources, cross-check for contradictory evidence, and document exact source URLs.
* **Task Construction:**
  Draft clear, answerable benchmark tasks designed specifically to expose structural weaknesses in model research strategies.
* **Red-Teaming & Model Testing:**
  Execute tasks against designated SOTA models to confirm they reliably trigger intended model failures.
* **Failure Diagnosis & Debugging:**
  Trace model run logs, search trajectories, and intermediate outputs to pinpoint exactly where and why the model failed (distinguishing genuine model limitations from ambiguous prompts).
* **Pattern Scaling & Review:**
  Apply validated "model-breaking" research patterns across new domains and, for strong performers, review tasks authored by peer trainers.
  **Strong Plus (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Bachelor or higher degree from relevant engineering domain is a must for this position.
* Prior experience specifically designing prompt-injection or reasoning-trap tasks that break SOTA models.
* Advanced OSINT capabilities or published investigative/academic research demonstrating deep source verification.
* Niche domain expertise in areas rich with hard-to-find records (e.g., local government filings, regional sports history, legal archives, historical patents).
* Experience serving as a lead reviewer, benchmark auditor, or quality owner on AI evaluation projects.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: Upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
* Engagement type: Contractor
* Engagement Length: upto 4 weeks

**Evaluation Process:**

* Candidates will be require to submit a
  **Job Interest Form & assessment**
  .
* Talents finalized in assessment will go through assessment, review & will proceed further accordingly.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description: What is Hunch?Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.Link to our fundraising announcementKey Offerings Of HunchOne Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.About The RoleWe're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.What You'll Do Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket. Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy). Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.) Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users. Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.What You'll Bring 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus. Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.Preferred ExperienceML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.What We OfferCompetitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).Life at HunchHunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.What We Hire For - The ABCsMost companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.How We WorkOwnership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.Backed by Global InvestorsHunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.Experienced LeadershipHunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Engineering Expert
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers specializing in engineering simulation and design to author and validate complex, simulation-based engineering problems for training and evaluating state-of-the-art AI agents. The role spans electrical, mechanical, control systems, aerospace, systems, and robotics engineering. You will create challenging, multi-constraint tasks that require agents to interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, identify reasoning and tool-use gaps, and build objective automated graders.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Author self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  
Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  
Analyze agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes, such as misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature convergence, or physically impossible geometries.
  
Refine benchmark difficulty based on model performance data while avoiding ambiguity or missing information.
  
Collaborate with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate rigorous benchmarks into model-evaluation pipelines.
  
Requirements
  
A master's degree or PhD in electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, and 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. The description also lists a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field as an education pathway.
  
Proficiency in at least one relevant open-source simulation package, such as ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, or Gmsh, along with strong Python scripting skills.
  
Hands-on experience with modern LLMs or coding agents and evaluation concepts such as pass@k, failure-mode analysis, and nondeterministic behavior; ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate reasoning or tool-use failures.
  
Strong attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  
A stable, high-speed internet connection and a personal computer suitable for remote work.
  
Availability for 40 hours per week, four hours of overlap with PST, and weekend on-call availability. Part-time engagement is also noted as acceptable.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
**What's In It For You**

* A core engineering seat: the agents are the product, and they are yours.
* An anchor client engagement already underway: your work ships into real, paying work within weeks, not a speculative roadmap.
* Competitive compensation.
* A genuinely AI-native engineering culture: agentic coding tools from day one, agent-per-human leverage, and the friction you hit becomes product input: we are user zero of our own platform.
* No legacy codebase and no bureaucracy, working alongside founders with deep services and product pedigree.
* The chance to build for regulated, high-stakes domains such as healthcare, life sciences, financial services, where quality and trust are the actual product.
* A modern office environment in Gurgaon, with a clear path to grow as the engineering organisation scales.

**Duties & Accountabilities**

* **Agent engineering:**
  design and build the initial BA, Dev, and QA agents: prompt architecture, context assembly, tool use, and schema-validated JSON outputs, with prompts and skills packs versioned in git and treated as core IP.
* **Retrieval & context:**
  build the codebase retrieval layer (syntax-aware chunking with tree-sitter, embeddings in pgvector) and the context-pack system: project glossary, org conventions, constraint register, and exemplar retrieval.
* **Evaluation harness:**
  own the golden dataset (25–30 expert-verified items) and the harness that runs nightly in CI: per-agent scores against published acceptance bars, trend monitoring, and regression alerts that block release.
* **Failure modes:**
  design for the ways agents fail: schema-repair loops, reject-loop re-invocation with reviewer comments injected, retrieval-verified symbols to guard against hallucinated APIs, and honest gap declaration over coverage inflation.
* **Confidence & quality:**
  implement and tune the confidence-scoring model that routes low-confidence outputs to senior review, and use every human modification (deltas captured at the gates) as improvement signal.
* **Token economics:**
  own cost per story: per-invocation token and cost telemetry, model-mix tuning (fast tier for enrichment and test generation, top tier for code), and budget-aware prompt design.
* **AI-native practice:**
  work daily with agentic coding tools; the friction you hit is product input.

**What We Will Look For**

* You ask how acceptance is measured before you ask what the prompt looks like. An evals-first mindset is the defining trait of this role.
* You have a working vocabulary for failure modes (hallucination, drift, coverage inflation, silent assumption-making), and you design around them rather than explaining them away.
* You treat prompt changes like code changes: versioned, tested against a regression set, and rolled back when the numbers say so.

**Education & Experience**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience, including 1.5+ years building LLM-powered applications in real production use, not prototypes or side projects.
* Demonstrable experience with retrieval-augmented generation and context engineering in a production system.
* Experience building or operating systematic evaluation for LLM outputs (golden datasets, regression harnesses, rubric scoring).
* Experience in a startup or small-team environment is a strong plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Technical Skills Required**

* Strong Python and production experience with LLM provider APIs (Anthropic Claude family experience valued); structured outputs and JSON-schema validation.
* Prompt and context engineering with measurable iteration, exemplar selection, context budgeting, instruction design for consistency.
* Embeddings and vector search in production (pgvector or similar); code-aware chunking and indexing is a strong plus.
* Evaluation engineering: building harnesses, defining acceptance bars, wiring them into CI, and reading the trends.
* Token and cost optimisation: metering, model-tier routing, and cost-per-outcome thinking.
* Agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph or similar) are a strong plus, as is SQL fluency for telemetry analysis.
* Practical, hands-on fluency with modern agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) is required.

**How We Hire**

Our process is designed to move from first contact to offer in about a week: a 30-minute screen (including a short live demonstration of how you work with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code; every engineer here works this way), a paid four-hour work sample, a founder interview, and references. If we are a mutual fit, you will know fast.

*To apply, or to discuss the role directly, reach out to the team.*

title: Technical Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**About ZENNER Aquamet**

At ZENNER Aquamet, we develop modern software solutions that power connected IoT ecosystems and enable secure,

data-driven decision-making. Our engineering teams build scalable web applications, APIs, and cloud-based services that

support customers across utilities, smart infrastructure, and industrial domains. We foster a collaborative environment

where engineers can learn, contribute, and grow through real-world product development.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a highly experienced, technically versatile, and hands-on Technical Lead to drive the design,

development, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise-grade software solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess comprehensive technical expertise across the entire software development lifecycle,

with the ability to independently architect, build, deploy, manage, and optimize complete software ecosystems. The role

requires a strong combination of software engineering, cloud computing, infrastructure management, system

architecture, and technical leadership capabilities.

The candidate must have proven experience working with Internet of Things (IoT) applications and platforms, along with

extensive hands-on expertise in both Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.

The selected professional will take end-to-end technical ownership of projects, resolve complex engineering challenges,

guide development teams, and ensure the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Take complete technical ownership of software projects, covering requirement analysis, technical planning,

solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

• Independently architect, design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications, mobile

applications, APIs, and cloud-based services.

• Design intuitive, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces while ensuring consistent user experience, performance,

and accessibility.

• Develop robust frontend and backend applications, reusable components, scalable services, and secure integration

mechanisms.

• Architect, deploy, configure, secure, and manage production environments on both AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Design and maintain databases, data processing pipelines, distributed systems, caching mechanisms, and highvolume data handling solutions.

• Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, infrastructure automation, and application

release processes.

• Ensure system availability, performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and disaster recovery across

production environments.

• Design and implement secure, scalable IoT applications, including device connectivity, telemetry processing, realtime monitoring, and third-party platform integrations.

• Establish software engineering standards, conduct code reviews, implement automated testing, and ensure

application and infrastructure security.

• Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving application performance, databases,

networking, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and production environments.

• Evaluate technology choices, define solution architectures, prepare technical documentation, and recommend

appropriate implementation approaches.

• Lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, coordinate development activities, and collaborate with

management and stakeholders to deliver business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

• Extensive hands-on proficiency in programming languages and modern application development technologies,

including Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SQL.

• Strong practical experience with modern frameworks and technologies such as Angular, React, Next.js, Django,

FastAPI, Node.js, or equivalent platforms.

• Experience designing and developing web and mobile applications along with a strong understanding of UI/UX

principles and design tools.

• Expert-level knowledge of both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including cloud networking, compute, storage, identity

management, security, managed databases, serverless computing, container orchestration, monitoring, and

infrastructure architecture.

• Advanced experience with Linux server administration, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub

Actions, Azure DevOps, and automated deployment workflows.

• Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with

experience in database design, query optimization, replication, and data processing.

• Extensive understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, message

brokers, asynchronous processing, and third-party integrations.

• Proven experience designing scalable, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure software solutions, including load

balancing, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.

• Strong experience with production monitoring, centralized logging, observability, incident management, and

troubleshooting using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch, and Azure Monitor.

• Hands-on knowledge of software testing methodologies, automated testing frameworks, API testing, performance

testing, application security, and secure coding practices.

• Mandatory experience with IoT applications and platforms, including device connectivity, telemetry ingestion, IoT

cloud services, and communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, UDP, LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, etc.

• Strong analytical ability, architectural decision-making, technical documentation, problem-solving, and leadership

skills.

**Eligibility Criteria**

• B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech/M.E., MCA, or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology,

Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, including hands-on development, solution architecture,

cloud infrastructure, and technical leadership.

• Proven experience leading complex software projects and independently managing technical responsibilities

throughout the complete software development lifecycle.

• Demonstrated expertise in designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads on both

AWS and Microsoft Azure.

• Prior professional experience working on IoT-based products, platforms, or enterprise IoT integration solutions is

mandatory.

• Proven ability to independently design, develop, deploy, and maintain complete enterprise software solutions.

• Strong technical leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Skills

• AWS and Microsoft Azure certifications in solution architecture, cloud engineering, DevOps, or related

specializations.

• Experience developing IoT solutions for smart metering, utilities, smart infrastructure, industrial systems, or device

management.

• Familiarity with LoRaWAN Network Servers (LNS), IoT gateways, communication protocols, and integration with

external IoT platforms.

• Experience working with multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud environments, large-scale distributed systems, and

enterprise security architectures.

• Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI-powered applications, and intelligent automation.

• Experience mentoring engineering teams, managing multiple technical initiatives, and providing technical guidance

across the software delivery lifecycle

Our purpose is to bring enjoyment to people’s lives through great tasting food, in a way which reflects our values. McCain has recently committed to implementing regenerative agriculture practices across 100 percent of our potato acreage by 2030. Ask us more about our commitment to sustainability.
  
  
**Overview**
As part of McCain digital transformation, we are making significant investments into our data structures and policies to increase the quality of our data, the confidence of our business teams to use this data to make decisions, and to drive value through the use of data.
  
  
We have an ambitious Global Data Governance team, which serves as an enabler to the business teams in our regions and global functions. We are currently recruiting an experienced Master Data Management Technical Process Engineer with strong MDG and ABAP technical understanding to support the governance and quality of Customer and Vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The MDM Technical Process Engineer will follow global processes and leverage global tools to govern data in a way that is consistent and standardized across all regions. As a member of the Data and Platform Governance team, this individual will implement and maintain data governance strategies, including enforcement of policies, guidelines, standards, and procedures.
  
  
The position supports Business Partner Master Data Governance within the SAP S/4HANA environment, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and compliance across the organization. Responsibilities include driving data quality initiatives, developing metrics and reports to monitor data integrity, performing root cause analysis of data issues, and contributing to system design improvements.
  
  
The role will also collaborate with SAP technical teams by supporting ABAP code analysis, BADI enhancements, integrations between the MDM platform and S/4 Hana, troubleshooting MDG-related logic and workflows impacting customer and vendor master data.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Maintain master data governance processes from definition through to execution and continuous improvement
* A key responsibility is configuring SimpleMDG modules for vendor and customer master (Business Partner), establishing business rules, approval workflows, and validation logic.
* Implement defined policies and frameworks specifically for vendor and customer master (Business Partner) data governance in the S/4HANA environment.
* Support the implementation of data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms
* Support the integration of master data management, data governance, and data quality tools/platforms with target systems like S/4 Hana, Salesforce, and the Enterprise Data Platform among others.
* Configure and support SAP MDG for Customer and Vendor Master, including data models, workflows, validation rules, and approval processes.
* Perform root cause analysis of data issues and ensure remediation according to data governance policies and standards.
* Develop audit and validation methods to ensure quality of the customer and vendor master data using AI-Driven and automated approaches.
* Assist with regular compliance reviews against policies and standards.
* Identify downstream impacts of master data change.
* Ensure proper monitoring of all integrations between the MDM Platform and other systems.

**Technical & ABAP Responsibilities**

* Analyze and interpret ABAP programs, user exits, BADIs, and enhancements related to Customer master data and SAP MDG processes.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of BADIs and other extension frameworks used in MDG validation, derivation, and workflow logic.
* Collaborate with ABAP development teams to analyze custom code and troubleshoot issues affecting master data governance processes.
* Perform technical analysis of SAP tables, CDS views, and data models to support data governance reporting and validation.
* Support debugging and root cause investigation of MDG workflows, rules, and integration issues impacting Customer master data.
* Work with technical teams to ensure custom developments align with MDG governance standards and best practices.
* Assist with impact analysis during system changes, upgrades, or SAP S/4HANA transformations affecting Customer master data structures

**Key Qualification & Experiences**

* Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience with data management/governance, including but not limited to data protection and/or data quality
* Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA, Master Data Governance (MDG) including configuration of data models, governance processes, and validations.
* Experience implementing MDM solutions in multiple organizations.
* Working knowledge of ABAP development concepts, including:

+ BADIs and enhancement framework
+ User exits and custom logic analysis
+ Debugging and code review
+ Understanding SAP tables and data models

* A certification like MDG100 will enhance the candite profile.
* Preferred: Experience working with PIM, Data Catalog, Data Governance, and MDM systems.
* Preferred: Understanding of CPG industry specifics — product hierarchies, SKU proliferation, and regulatory data requirements.
* Experience harmonizing systems, processes, and/or data across business areas and functions
* Experience working on an agile team in a virtual, distributed environment

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and participate as an independent contributor with little supervision

description:

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Engineer II Software Development – Platform Experience

Join the Platform Experience team, a core group within our GPTO Engineering organization, where you will report to the Director of Engineering. Our team is on a mission to provide the unshakeable foundation of trust, security, and scale for the entire Anaplan ecosystem. We empower our internal developers and external partners to build with speed and confidence.

 

 

**Your Impact**

 

* Contribute significantly to the design and execution of our Platform Experience, playing a vital role across Product Security, Platform Management, and Data Integration initiatives.

* Design, build, and 

  maintain

  the 

  highly available

  , secure, and scalable services that form the backbone of our platform.

* Champion engineering excellence through high-quality, hands-on coding, collaborative design reviews, and mentorship of junior engineers on our backend technology stack (Java, Kotlin, Go, .NET).

* Actively 

  participate

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers and other engineering groups, to deliver robust and reliable platform solutions.

 

**Your Qualifications**

 

* A strong seniority in full-stack web development ideally using Frontend technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, React.js, Redux and Backend such as Java, Kotlin, Spring Framework, MySQL

* Proficiency in using REST APIs or similar for data integration.

* Experience working in production with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Helm

* Experience with building observability into services to track usage and health (Grafana stack)

* A deep understanding of the value of testing to deliver a high-quality product.

* Working knowledge of containers and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

* Experience working closely with product management and UX teams to deliver the best solution to the problem at hand.

* A strong background in fostering a culture of continuous delivery, test automation and agile development.

* Experience in ExpressJS/Next.js, Webpack, WebSocket, Gulp are a plus

* Strong communication and collaboration skills - you are pragmatic and know how to build trust.

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Skills**

 

* Experience with

   private and

   public cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

* Proven ability to influence your team's technical decisions and lead projects to completion.

* Experience

   with CI/CD best practices

  , 

  infrastructure-as-code tools (like Terraform).

 
**Experience**
- 6- 12 Years

*We know that great talent comes from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification on this list.*

 

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Product Executive
description:
* **Company Description**
  NFX Digital is a data-driven digital marketing company transforming the consumer and marketing research landscape in India. Through its flagship platform Adytude.com, NFX Digital blends traditional research instruments with innovative, digital-first methodologies to deliver fast, cost-effective, and statistically robust insights

**About the Role**

* **Experience:**

  1–2 years
* **Work Mode:**

  Full-time, Work from Office

NFX Digital is looking for a technically strong, product-obsessed
**Product Executive with hands-on experience building an AI SaaS product**

.

We are looking for someone who has been involved in taking a software product from an idea or early development stage to a working product. You should understand how AI SaaS products are built, how features move from requirements to implementation, and how to identify and solve problems throughout the product development lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get deeply involved in building, testing, improving, and scaling an AI SaaS product. You will work closely with the founders and engineering team, contribute to product decisions, and take ownership of features from conception through execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Development and Ownership**

* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to build and improve our AI SaaS product.
* Understand the product architecture, core features, user workflows, and technical dependencies.
* Translate business problems and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable feature specifications.
* Take ownership of features from initial research and requirement gathering through development, testing, and release.
* Identify product gaps and proactively recommend improvements.

**2. AI SaaS Product Research and Strategy**

* Research competing AI SaaS products, their features, positioning, user experience, and underlying capabilities.
* Analyse customer needs and market opportunities to identify areas where the product can differentiate itself.
* Evaluate feature requests critically, prioritising those that deliver meaningful value to users.
* Help the team maintain a clear product focus instead of building features without a strong use case.

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Work directly with developers to understand technical feasibility, dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
* Break down product requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and clear development tasks.
* Understand APIs, integrations, databases, and software workflows at a practical level.
* Participate in technical and product discussions, asking the right questions and helping resolve ambiguity.

**4. Product Testing and Quality**

* Test new features, integrations, and releases thoroughly.
* Identify bugs, edge cases, usability issues, and inconsistencies.
* Document issues with reproducible steps, screenshots or evidence, and expected outcomes.
* Validate fixes and ensure that released features solve the intended problem.
* Continuously explore the product to identify opportunities for improvement.

**5. User Experience and Product Improvement**

* Evaluate the product from the user's perspective and identify friction points.
* Use customer feedback, product usage data, and research to inform product decisions.
* Improve onboarding, feature discoverability, usability, and overall product experience.
* Help ensure the product is intuitive, reliable, and valuable to its target customers.

**Required Qualifications**

* **1–2 years of relevant experience**

  , with demonstrable hands-on involvement in building an AI SaaS product.
* Experience working on an AI SaaS product during its development, launch, or early growth stage.
* A technical educational background, preferably in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* A practical understanding of the AI SaaS product development lifecycle.
* Experience working with developers and translating requirements into product features.
* Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, databases, and web application workflows.
* Experience with product documentation, feature specifications, user stories, and QA testing.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What We Value Most**

We are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with the product they are building.

You should be someone who:

* Wants to understand how every important part of the product works.
* Has experienced the realities of building an AI SaaS tool, including bugs, technical constraints, changing requirements, and iteration.
* Is comfortable getting hands-on rather than limiting themselves to meetings and documentation.
* Can independently investigate a problem, develop a point of view, and recommend a solution.
* Understands that building a good product means making deliberate choices about what to build and what not to build.
* Takes ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks.
* Is curious, resourceful, and willing to challenge assumptions.
* Cares deeply about product quality and the value delivered to customers.

**Work Arrangement**

This is a full-time, work-from-office position at NFX Digital. The candidate must be comfortable working from the office and collaborating closely with the founders and engineering team throughout the product development process.

**Growth Opportunity**

This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an AI SaaS product, work directly with decision-makers, and develop into a Product Manager as the product and team grow.

* **Application Requirement**

Along with your CV, please share details of an AI SaaS product you have worked on. Explain your role in building it, the features you contributed to, the challenges you encountered, and how your work improved the product.

Candidates should be prepared to discuss their actual product-building experience during the interview.
